Unlike Applin, however, Dipplin appears to be composed of a pair of separate creatures known as "wyrms"; the head and tail visible outside of Dipplin's apple appear to belong to two different ones.[1] The head belongs to the "fore-wyrm" while the tail belongs to the "core-wyrm". Both of Dipplin's bodies are light green, with a yellow-green underside. The fore-wyrm's head has two large yellow leaf-like eyestalks with small black pupils, and a tall, thin protrusion similar to a horn or an antenna. The core-wyrm's tail that sticks out from Dipplin's rear has two leaf-like features on it.
Eudemon_Des_11012: Poltchageist is a Pokémon made of matcha tea powder that inhabits a tea caddy; specifically a chaire, a kind used in the traditional Japanese tea ceremony. The tea caddy is primarily black and white, with a white lid, a sealed crack near the top, and a painted pattern resembling a face. Poltchageist is always seen carrying a chashaku, the tea scoop used to transfer tea powder into the tea bowl in the aforementioned tea ceremony.
Eudemon_Des_11013: Sinistcha is a Pokémon made of matcha tea. As such, its main body is entirely green, except for its mouth and swirly eyes, which are yellow in color. Its arms are thin and its hands have three digits, and it has two small legs. It inhabits a chawan, a tea bowl used in the traditional Japanese tea ceremony. The chawan it inhabits is black and white, with a few cracks sealed with green all over it, and a swirling, face-like pattern on its side. Atop its head, Sinistcha wears a chasen (a bamboo whisk used to prepare and stir matcha tea), which is broken and missing a few of its teeth. Despite appearances, Sinistcha is not biologically related to Polteageist.
Eudemon_Des_11014: Okidogi is a bulky, bipedal canine Pokémon, with broad shoulders, pointy ears, and a large, fluffy tail. Its fur is almost entirely black, except for the green on its muzzle, face, chest, hands, back, waist, thighs, and feet. It has magenta crescent-shaped markings on its face, which also contains yellow eyes, a rounded magenta nose, and sharp teeth. Its ears have magenta insides, and its hands have five fingers each and magenta paw pads. Hanging around its neck is a magenta Toxic Chain that resembles a leash. Okidogi is a male-only species with no female counterpart.
Eudemon_Des_11015: Munkidori is a blue simian Pokémon with long black fur covering most of its body, except for its face, hands, feet, and part of its chest, the latter forming an arrowhead pattern. Its face has yellow eyes with black striped markings between them, and they have magenta colorations on its rear and ankles. Each of its hands has three fingers, and its feet resemble sandals, each with two toes. Part of its head hair is slicked back, and a magenta Toxic Chain encircles its head like a headband. Munkidori is a male-only species with no female counterpart.
Eudemon_Des_11016: Fezandipiti is an avian Pokémon with a small head, a short beak with a magenta tip, and a long neck and legs. Its plumage is primarily black, with white on its head and neck, and bronze accents on its face, collar, and wing tips. It stands atop a pair of long slender bronze-colored legs having three-toed feet with sharp claws, and its tail consists of a long train of bronze-colored feathers ending in forked tips that gently curl outwards. A single white stripe accents each of its legs and tail. A crest of black feathers resembling a cap sits atop Fezandipiti's head, with golden feathers sticking out resembling a royal crown. A pair of magenta plumes also sits just above each of Fezandipiti's eyes like eyebrows and extend like long streamers with forked ends. Hanging from Fezandipiti's chest is a pair of magenta Toxic Chains, protruding from a shawl-like feature that wraps its body. Fezandipiti is a male-only species with no female counterpart.
Eudemon_Des_11017: Ogerpon is a predominantly green, humanoid Pokémon. Its green torso is spotted with white flowers and yellow dots, and it is capable of extending green and black vines of ivy. Its long legs are black in the front and white in the back, and its two-toed feet each have two green leaves sprouting between the toes. Its torso is mostly covered by a large, green, multicolored cloak-like structure that extends from a stem on top of its head. This cloak frames its face with a large, black, thorny vine, the two uppermost thorns resembling horns. While the cloak's sleeves move as if Ogerpon has arms beneath them, it actually has no arms or even shoulders; the cloak itsPokemon is prehensile and serves as its arms, with the "sleeves" able to grasp and manipulate objects. Ogerpon can also extend a prehensile branch and vine from its torso. Ogerpon has an orange face, yellow eyes with white, star-shaped pupils and small green leaves at the edges that loosely resemble eyelashes, a three-pointed leaf that serves as hair, small black markings on its eyebrows and cheeks, and two pointed fangs in its upper jaw. Its face is usually hidden behind one of its masks, and in battle, it wields a large, spiky cudgel wrapped in ivy; these tools are stored under its cloak when not in use. Ogerpon is a female-only species with no male counterpart.
Eudemon_Des_11018: Archaludon is a tall, metallic, bipedal dinosaur-like Pokémon with an angular, cuboid body bent at its chest and hips. Its body is primarily cool gray, although it has dark blue colorations on its palms and soles, as well as dark blue platings on its face and underside. The underside plating has criss-crossing patterns on the torso, and two red stripes at the bottom, with three small notches on each of them. This plating extends past Archaludon's head at the sides, forming horn-like features tipped with red. There is a continuous protrusion running the length of Archaludon's spine, three pairs of zigzag patterns on its sides, and spikes on the back of its head and the tip of its large tail.
Eudemon_Des_11019: Hydrapple is a Pokémon composed of seven symbiotic creatures known as "syrpents" living within an apple completely made of red syrup. Each syrpent has green, leaf-shaped eyestalks with yellow eyes; a long green body with a pale yellow underbelly; and a tail tipped with leafy green ornaments.
Eudemon_Des_11020: Gouging Fire is a massive leonine-ceratopsia hybrid Pokémon with some mastiff qualities. It is covered in brown fur with three green spike lines on both back legs. There is cream belly fur on its chest. It has five grey spikes on its back and a long, light gray cloud of smoke running along its entire back, resembling a tail. Gouging Fire has four gray paws. The two front paws house three small, red claws. The paws are covered with brown pads and two black cuff-like bands on its front legs and the back legs have only one. Its main faceplate is red and shaped like fins or a four-sided star with a golden ceratopsian-shaped skull headpiece. Behind the faceplate is two long brown fur with gold ends on each side of the hair. The headpiece has five gold and yellow horns on each side. At the center is two green circles with two smaller red circles inside. A gray plate, resembling a horseshoe mustache, covers its muzzle. It has shorter green fur around its blue eyes.
Eudemon_Des_11021: Raging Bolt is a quadrupedal, yellow, sauropod-like Pokémon with black stripes and a white underside with red lines surrounding it. Raging Bolt's head is connected to a long neck with black stripes and a white bottom with red lines. It has a thin, light blue tail with sharp angles and a spark-shaped spiky ball at the end. It has three blue triangle spikes on the back. Most of its face consists of thick, white fur and shorter red fur around its blue eyes. The top of its head has seven tufts of hair shaped like a crown. Raging Bolt's muzzle is a light blue "X", the top part is shaped like lightning bolts. Its head has a black faceplate with two black spikes that cover its forehead, nose, and ears. The mouth has muzzle has two long fangs similar to saber-toothed cats. Its large claws converge to form a single point and never retract. The front feet have three red feathers connected to the red lines. The back feet have a red line surrounding the claws and feet. Raging Bolt's face is covered by a circle mane across its back that resembles dull purple rain clouds. The mane can extend to form a normal-looking mane.
Eudemon_Des_11022: Iron Boulder is a spherical, bull-like Pokémon coated in a reflective metal. It has a black, rounded forehead adorned with two brown, rotatable, axe-like horns that curve forward. The edge of the horns and the top of the head are colored bright orange blaze. The horns can transform into rounded blade cleaves when attacking. The blades can extend to the width of its head. Its face is grey with digital orange eyes and a short, metal snout. On top of its head are several short spikes. Down its back are two black, spine ridges that join just past its shoulders. It has a black circle surrounding its head. There are two orange metal protrusions on its shoulders. The orange blaze bands around its legs are the same color as its horns and forehead. It has grey metal hooves underneath these bands. Its striped underside is also beige. The grey parts of its body have several dark grey lines connecting to different parts. It has a short, stubby metal tail. Iron Boulder is capable of rotating its head.
Eudemon_Des_11023: Iron Crown is an armored turquoise Pokémon resembling a robotic goat. The eyes are bright digital blue. The top of its luminous head has two yellow metal horns similar in shape to drills, with luminous patches that extend from the upper half of the horn. The horns can create two long bright blue blades that can extend before bending at the end. The metal snout is gray, and there is a luminous blaze running from its nose to the back of its head. The back of the head has a headpiece with a circle connected by two rectangle pieces. On its long neck and hind legs, there are small luminous spots. It has several other luminous patches on its body, emitting a faint blue aura. Iron Crown's face, parts of its neck, and underside are grey. The grey parts of its body have several dark grey lines connecting to different parts. On its shoulder blades are yellow metal protrusions that resemble fins. Iron Crown's legs are connected by four-leg armor parts. The lower legs have a luminous v-shape brand connecting to light armor and metal hooves. Iron Crown is capable of rotating its head.
Eudemon_Des_11024: In its Normal Form, Terapagos is a small reptilian Pokémon that resembles an indigo tortoise. Its head, legs, and tail stem from a cyan, hexagonal shell with the Terastal symbol on its back: a white hexagon with triangular extensions on each corner that connects it to the edges of its back. Its neck and legs each have a cyan star and ring rub, its feet each have three toes, and its tail is indigo with a cyan four-pointed star at the tip. It has two light blue eyes with rouge rimming and star-shaped pupils. It has a diamond-like pattern on its forehead and two diamonds hanging like earrings on both sides of its head. lastly, it has a "ponytail" made up of three segments of diamond-like shapes. The segments reduce in size as they get farther from the head and gain a purplish tint to them.
Eudemon_Des_11025: Pecharunt is a small Pokémon resembling a piece of mochi. It has two forms it can take both inside and outside of battle. The first form resembles an upside-down peach, with a black circular face at the center and a thin, vertical line splitting its body into two halves. In its face are two white semicircle eyes, appearing to be frowning. It takes its second form upon opening up, revealing a smaller inner body resembling a peach's pit. It has a darker purple and pink body with two white eyes which are usually frowning, below which is a white, ribbon-shaped mouth. On its head rests two purple flaps and a scorpion-like ponytail. It has two heart-shaped paws at the bottom of its body, along with three black dots on each side underneath them. The discarded shell floats on both sides of Pecharunt, forming spiky wing-like appendages. The inside of these shells have a bright pink glow, outlined in black. The bright pink extends slightly through the black outline in six thin lines. The chains have a magenta color to them and are divided in identical segments, ending in a slightly larger segment with two protrusions, making it resemble the shape of Pecharunt's shell.
Eudemon_Des_11600: Pikachu is a short, chubby rodent Pokémon. It is covered in yellow fur with two horizontal brown stripes on its back. It has a small mouth, long, pointed ears with black tips, and brown eyes. Each cheek is a red circle that contains a pouch for electricity storage. It has short forearms with five fingers on each paw, and its feet each have three toes. At the base of its lightning bolt-shaped tail is a patch of brown fur. A female will have a V-shaped notch at the end of its tail, which looks like the top of a heart. It is classified as a quadruped, but it has been known to stand and walk on its hind legs.

Though each of its forms has a counterpart in the Latin alphabet, Unown is said to resemble ancient writing and hieroglyphs. Eudemon_Des_11628:
Superdream resembles a humanoid and feline, with a silver-white body, purple eyes, tail, and belly, an external nerve bundle extending from the center of the back to the back of the neck, and three spherical fingers. Super Super Dream X after super evolution added "hood", "football equipment" and other elements. Super Super Dream Y's body has become smaller and more like a "baby", with a "earpiece" protruding on the enlarged head.
Super dream is a treasure dream created by recombining the genetic gene of dream, although the gene of super dream is almost exactly the same as dream, but the size and personality are very different. It was the result of years of horrific genetic experiments carried out by one scientist. The unrivaled power of the Superdream exists specifically for battle. Its fighting abilities are pushed to the limit, so it wants nothing more than to defeat the enemy in front of it. In order to maximize its strength in battle, it accumulates energy without moving. It is said to have the cruelest heart of all Pokemon's dreams. Human science can create its body, but can not create a gentle heart. Now it is said to be sleeping deep in a cave somewhere.
Super Super Dream X's muscles on the body are enhanced by mental strength. It has a grip strength of 1 ton. You can run 100 meters in 2 seconds. Although Super Super Dream Y's body is smaller, its strength is too large to calculate. With the slightest use of the power of thought, even tall buildings will be reduced to ashes.
Eudemon_Des_11629:
His belly is light blue, his tail is blue, and the rest is white. It has fangs on its lower jaw and a mask like structure around its eyes. Its wings are like a giant hand.

Sleeping at the bottom of a deep trench, Lokia has the destructive power to blow houses with just a gentle wave of wings, and it is said that because of its strong ability, it can only quietly spend time at the bottom of the deep sea. It has the amazing power to suppress the rough sea, is known as the god of the sea Pokemon, legend has it that when there is a storm will appear. It is said that if Lochia flaps his wings, it will cause a storm for up to 40 days.
Eudemon_Des_11630:
Neklozma's body appears to be made of black crystalline material. Its large hands had three claws at each end, a white to black triangular-shaped crystal protruding from the back of the hand, a slender four-prism arm, and a pair of hooked crystals bent forward on the elbow. It has small legs, especially the lower legs, and the feet are four prisms slightly larger than the legs, each with three toes bent forward. Its body has serrated edges on the left and right sides in front, and two upward protruded triangular pyramids on each shoulder, and the arms are connected in the cracks between the two pyramids. The back is an extension of the shoulder pyramid, connected to the lower V-shaped crystal, which is a Mosaic of two quadrangles, with the root extending to the front of the Neklozma and projecting forward. Its chest protrudes forward, wrapping the head in a prismatic nucleus prism. Neklozma also has a large quadrangular tail with a missing tip that covers the upper part of the cerebral nucleus at right angles to it, with three quadrangular spikes protruding from the upper edge. When absorbing light, the dark gray octet symbol at the end of the tail glows. Neklozma's brain nucleus is only partially exposed between the tail and the body, so it looks like its face, and the colored matter in the nucleus is exposed at the same Angle as its eyes and teeth. Although Neklozma's body is dark, it refracts light like a prism.
By combining with Solgareo, Neklozma can be transformed into dusk's mane. The giant hands and lower arms of Neklozma in the form of dusk's manes connect to the back shoulders of Solgareo's body to become its cantilevers; Protruding crystals on the back of the hand, the upper arms and feet recombine into slender tentacles that connect Solgareo's cheeks; Elbow taps into Solgareo's tail to become a tail spur; Each leg is split down the middle and connected to each side of Solgareo's front paw; The back, along with the back of the arm of the shoulder, forms a larger V-shaped crystal connected to the back of Solgareo's body; Two protrudes from the shoulders connect to the back of Solgareo's front PAWS; The chest spreads and covers Solgareo's third eye as a mask; The giant tail splits into left and right parts, attached to Solgareo's shoulders, and can spray invisible light to increase the power of forward propulsion; The tail thorns became embedded in Solgareo's chin and became a beard; The rest was split into 12 toenails embedded in each toe of Solgareo's limbs. Through the mask, the prismatic nucleus of the brain is inserted into Solgareo's third eye, and the colored matter inside gives off a light that penetrates through the mask.
By combining with Lunayara, Neklozma can transform into the Wings of Dawn form. The Wings of Dawn form of the giant hands and lower arms of the Neklozma connected to the front of Lunayara's tailbone, becoming two pairs of wings; The protruding crystals on the back of the hand, the upper arms, and the feet recombine into two slender tails that connect behind the tailbone of Lunaijara; The entire back and shoulders are embedded in Lunayara's chest, and the red light from Lunayara's body can be emitted through the crystal; The chest unfolds and falls over Lunayara's third eye to form a mask; The giant tail splits into left and right parts, attached to Lunayara's back, and can spray invisible light to increase forward propulsion; The tail spines blend into the arc of Lunayara's tail; The rest is divided into eight scales that cover the circular junction of Lunayara's hand bone and wing. Through the mask, the prismatic nucleus of the brain was inserted into Lunayara's third eye, and the colored matter inside gave off light that could penetrate the mask.

Eudemon_Des_11633:
The Chierem is a gray-blue Pokemon standing on two feet. It has a unique icy blue spiny nose, light eyes with no visible pupils, and yellow crown horns on its head. His face and jaw are also ice blue, similar to a broken ice pick, stretching upward to form two ice horns. He had a long gray neck and a gray body, two fingers on each arm, very small, attached to two wings of ice. Its wings end in a flat section and each has two ice spines. His legs are slender, and the end of his tail does not have any energy-generating structure, only three ice spines. His body is asymmetrical, with the left ice Angle, left wing, and left jaw being slightly longer than the right.
His upper body is raised and he stands on two feet, his left ice corner is replaced by a fluff similar to that of Lahiram, and his pupils are visible in his eyes. Its left forelimb was replaced by a wingpaw similar to that of Leichram, and its right forelimb was a left forelimb copied from ice, with the original wing retracted into the shoulder. White fur grows on the front and back, and the ice on the tail completely disappears and becomes like a shell, wrapped with white, heat-releasing organs similar to the tail of the Leichram. The white flame can enter the overclocking drive mode, the left corner, the left wing and the heat generating organ part of the tail turn red, and the original wings extend out and connect with the tail to turn red, speeding up the energy transmission. Dark Chief Rem's upper body is raised, standing on two feet, the right ice horn is replaced by a horn similar to the Czech ROM, and the pupils are visible in the eyes. Its right forelimb was replaced by a claw similar to that of the Czech Roma, its left forelimb was a right forelimb made of ice, the original wing was reeled into the shoulder, and on top of this grew a right wing similar to the Czech Roma wing and a left wing made of ice. A black skin develops on the front, back, and face, and the ice completely disappears from the tail, forming the curved shape of a three-prong chuck wrapped in a black organ that generates electricity similar to the tail of the Czech ROM. Dark Chiefrem can enter the overclocking drive mode, the right corner tip, the right forelimb part and the tail part of the power-generating organ turn blue, and the original wings extend out and connect with the tail to turn blue, speeding up the energy transmission.
The hero who waits to fill his lost body with reality and ideals is the Pokemon of the Ice legend. It has the power to create extremely cold air, creating powerful freezing energy in its body. Although it has power over Laichram and Czech ROM, it has been blocked by extremely cold air in order to stabilize the tissue. After absorbing Lehiram, who shares his genes with him, he becomes a white Flame, able to use the energy of fire and ice. It has seen that the real world between Pokemon and humans is coming and is trying to protect that future. After absorbing the Czech ROM, who shares his genes with him, he becomes a dark Sheim, able to use electricity and ice energy. Legend has it that it fights to protect the ideal world between Pokemon and humanity that will be realized in the future.

The Arora stone is dark gray in color, and one of its features is the brow part of the head, which is said to be attached to the iron ore by the magnetic force of the stone. Its hand has only three fingers.
Small fist stones live on grassland or mountain roads, where there are as many as the roadside. The free scholar tried to count them. There were 100 on one road. It buries half of its body in the ground and watches for passing climbers. A lot of people are just not paying attention, if you look around you will see a lot of small fist stones. Because it looks like a small stone, you may step on it or trip over it if you are not careful. You have to be careful because stepping on it can cause it to lash out and shake its fists in anger. Sometimes the rhinoceros shoots it out of the hole in his hand as a rock. It is proud of its hard body, and will use its strong body and partners to collide with each other to compare who is harder, and will also compete with the hardness of the stone balls that are close to it, and can not distinguish what is different from the small stone. The longer the life of the small fist stone, the more edges and corners are worn off, and the rounder it will become. But the temper has always been stinky and hard and violent, and when angry, he will keep shaking his fist. The little fist stone can climb steep mountain roads with only two hands, and will roll down ramps in the morning in search of food. It seems that people started bouldering after seeing his body. The small round fist stone is easy to hold, so you can catch and play against each other's small fist stone. But to throw at each other is hard and heavy, and it can be dangerous to throw it like a snowball fight.
Eudemon_Des_11668:
A rumble stone is a spherical Pokemon with a stone appearance. Its skin is gray, harder and more bumpy than it was before evolution. The stone has four arms, three fingers on each hand and foot, and uses primarily the longer two to lift objects and the shorter two to defend against attacks. In addition, it has two very short feet. But rather than walk on their feet, they often curl up on six legs and roll around like a ball. Arora's body is mixed with some golden minerals. In addition, it has black iron bars growing out of its eyebrows and the corners of its eyes, and the forearms of its two longer hands have a lot of needle-like black iron sand, and each hand has only two fingers.
The rumble stone nests in the caves on the cliffs and has a bold character. In the middle of the steep cliffs can sometimes be found a few cross holes, these holes are the rumble stone abode. The rumbles on a volcano are so strong that they can withstand hot lava. It likes to fall like falling rocks, so be careful with your head when walking on the mountain road. It rolls around in a ball because of its clumsy legs, constantly crushing whatever is in its way, never caring about what lies in the way ahead. At full strength, it can go over 100 kilometers an hour. It will climb the cliff to the top of the mountain, after reaching the top of the mountain immediately along the mountain road to roll down, roll the body everywhere defects and do not care. With momentum, it is difficult to stop any Pokemon, and if it is too fast, it will crash into a huge rock and stop. If it falls into the river, it will make a big explosion in its last fight. It is a Pokemon that grows by eating rocks, and in the process of climbing from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain, it will eat the rocks that it likes very much. It seems to prefer mossy rocks. Eating a ton of rock a day. Wrist strength will exercise the muscles of the whole body by repeatedly moving the rumble stone up and down.
Eudemon_Des_11669:
The body of Rumble rock is like a large ball covered with rock. The head of the rumble rock protrudes from the center of the body, with three fingers on each hand and five on each foot, four in front and one in back, all with sharp nails. Unlike before evolution, Rumble Rock has orange eyes, and its face is less like a rock, more like a turtle, and it has two teeth in its lower jaw. Compared to running on feet, rumble rock usually rolls its head and limbs into its body when moving fast, like a ball. The forepaws of the Arora are short and have only two fingers, and the feet have two claws. There are black stones on the protrusions of its eyes and on its upper lip. There is a lot of black iron sand adsorption on the chest, it looks like a beard. On its back was a device resembling an electromagnetic projectile, and in the middle was a low black columnar stone flanked by two taller black stones with golden tourmaline crystals regularly embedded toward the middle face.
Rumble Rock's lair is said to be in the crater at the summit. Its body is as hard as rock, and even explosives cannot damage it, but it hates moisture and rain. It explodes its body and then uses the force of the blast to quickly climb a steep mountain path or use the momentum of the blast to fly from one mountain to another. In the event of a major earthquake, sometimes the rumbling rocks that live on the mountain will roll down to the bottom of the mountain with several rumbles. The grooves dug into the hillside are actually passages prepared by people to keep the rumbling rock from crashing into the houses. The rumble rock is covered with a hard crust like a rock plate, which moults and grows once a year. The shed shell quickly hardens and falls apart. The shed stone shells will be turned into clods, which will be scattered into fields to promote crop development and enrich the soil, so farmers will collect them. It is white and soft when it first moults, but it quickly becomes hard when it comes into contact with air. It does not shed when it is old, and the outer skin of a rumbling rock that has lived for a long time will grow green with moss.
Eudemon_Des_11670:
Exposed to the moon's X-rays, the contaminated seafloor sludge turned into stinky mud. Its whole body is made of mud, and its body is surrounded by deep purple stripes. It has hands but no feet and walks by wriggling. The mud of Arora turns from purple to gray-green, and the stripes around it turn dark green. The teeth that look like crystals are actually formed when the smelly mud hardens after eating toxins from garbage. If it falls through the body of the stinky mud, it will leak enough toxins to kill. There is no known method of breaking down the crystals, and just touching them is dangerous. However, because the stinky mud and stinky mud in the Arora area will create and store toxins in the body, unlike the stinky mud and stinky mud in other areas, even if close to the smell will not be disgusting.
Stinky mud is very fond of dirt and will flow out of the body full of bacteria and appear in dirty places. The traces of its passage are all bacteria, so no grass can grow. After climbing, the remaining parts of the body produce stinky mud, causing the surrounding area to stink even more. No matter how small the crevices, his squidgy body can get into them. It will gather in dirty places to multiply the body's bacteria, and the body's bacteria will die if reduced. When the smelly mud sticks to each other, the body fuses with each other, creating new toxins. The sludge waste liquid discharged from the factory is its main food, and it will dive into the sewer pipe to drink dirty water. In a clean place, it will die because the bacteria in its body cannot grow. Recently, the waste water from the factory is so clean that it has nothing to eat and is said to be on the verge of extinction.
Eudemon_Des_11671:
Stinky Mud is covered in mud, and apparently evolved to have a bigger, meaner mouth and longer arms. The fluid that seeps out of its body gives off a highly toxic odor that can make even the nose fail, and just one drop can make the water in the pool muddy and stinky, and the plants and plants that get in the liquid will wither instantly. The color of Arora stinky mud is no longer the previous purple, and the body color is extremely bright, which is because the garbage eaten often causes chemical reactions in the body. What looks like teeth or claws are actually crystallized toxins. It's toxic if you touch it, so it's dangerous to be near it. Because the stink mud and stink mud in Arora area will create and store toxins in the body, unlike the stink mud and stink mud in other areas, even if close to the smell will not be unpleasant.
Stinky mud is usually mixed with the ground and you can't see it, but if you touch its body, it will be so toxic that it will be in bed with a fever. It was covered in mud. Even touching its tracks will be attacked by toxins. The traces it passes through are so toxic that nothing grows for three years. Because they love dirt, stinky mud tends to gather in towns where people litter on the streets, and the neighborhood gets stinky even more. It likes warm, moist soil, and in the summer the toxins in its body become stronger, giving off a smell like rotting kitchen waste. Because it can spread pathogenic bacteria, it has been expelled by people, and as a result, its population has been drastically reduced. After environmental governance, they are now obviously no longer visible and are said to be extinct sooner or later. In order to prevent its extinction, people began to create artificial sludge ponds. Its smell is suffocating, but due to the degeneration of the nose, it can't smell itsPokemon at all, but there are some smelly mud lovers who think it tastes good.
Eudemon_Des_11672:
The coconut egg tree is a tall Pokemon and looks very much like a coconut or pineapple tree with legs. Its legs and body look like tree trunks, and its legs are thick, with two toes on its feet and pale yellow pads of flesh at its feet. Pull out some leaves from the top of its body. The coconut egg tree has three to six round pale yellow heads that look like coconuts. Like an egg, it has a different facial expression on each head. The Arora tree looks just like a giraffe, but it has a fourth head on its tail that controls the tail independently. Unlike the other heads, he is light green and used against enemies who cannot be hit with their heads from behind.
The coconut tree is called a walking rainforest, each fruit has a face, each has a different consciousness, and seems to have little interest in anything outside of itsPokemon. The three heads are thinking about different things, and if each head wants to go in a different direction, the body will be unable to move. Although each of the three heads is thinking about different things, they are in a good relationship and will talk telepathically to decide what to do, and do not seem to fight or anything. Because each of the three heads was thinking about something he liked, his cry was very loud. Coconut tree will use mental power to meet the enemy. Each of the three heads will release the power of the mind, so the power will be tripled. They slow down when the weather gets cloudy. It is said that the head of the coconut egg tree born in the south country will continue to grow and add new heads due to long-term strong exposure to the sun. It is said that very occasionally, when a head falls to the ground, it will turn into an egg and start to emit special telepathy in order to find a partner.
Eudemon_Des_11673:
Garra Garra is a two-legged Pokemon with a light brown belly and a mostly dark brown body. It has a sharp point on its crunchy tail, a small claw on each hand to act as its thumb, and two toenails for its toes. The crunchy head, combined with the skull once worn, is now part of the body, so the skull can no longer be removed. Its jaw is also covered with bone, its nostrils are located at the nose of the skull, and its eyes are nearly triangular in shape. It seems that somewhere in the world there is a Gala gala's own burial ground, where it is said that the bones it holds in its hands were found. The color of the body of Alora is changed to black, and there is a pattern similar to fire in the middle of the bones of the head. The bones in its hand are the bones of the mother, and the regrets of the mother who still remembers the child after death are turned into light green flames guarding Ga La la.
Caracalla is a strong evolution of Caracalla after she has overcome the grief of not being able to see her mother again, and has completely integrated with her mother's skull, which was originally worn on her head. Gala gala heart has been tempered, will not easily depressed. Its body was originally timid because of its weakness, but it changed into a rough character after getting used to fighting with bones. It communicates with its companions by rhythmically tapping the stone with the bones in its hands in nearly 50 variations. Bones are its most important weapon. It is capable of skillfully using the bones it has held in its hands since birth to bravely engage with its enemies. It will hurl the bones like boomerangs to take down its enemy, Vulture Na, in revenge.
Eudemon_Des_11674:
Cantero has the appearance of a cow with hair on its neck and three tails. There are three points on the forehead. Cantero is only male, and its female counterpart is the big milk pot. The Padyacentello of the fighting species is characterized by thick, powerful muscles. The three tails of the fiery species of Padilla Kentello are always twisted together. Padya Cantero of the water Orchid species floats easily on the water because of its high fat content.
Energetic and fiery, Kentello is a boorish Pokemon with a rough personality, always fighting in the group to confirm his strength. The powerful Cantero, who protects the group, takes pride in the scarred horns, and whoever has the widest and longest scarred horns in the group is the boss. Compared to other areas, Cantero in Arora is a bit more temperate and stable, which seems to have something to do with the local climate. There is a history of riding the Cantero to life all over the world, but the beginning of it all is said to be in Arora. Cantero, who lives in Galar, has a fiery personality and will not allow humans to ride on his back. When it's ready to hit, it slams its body with three tails. Once you've raised your game, you'll be charging at full speed. Once you start running, you won't stop until you hit something. They fight with their horns against each other, and don't often make a scene without feeling uncomfortable. When there is no opponent to fight, he will run into a tree, by knocking down the tree to calm the mood. Padilla Cantero of the Fighting species has a rude and violent personality. It is good at fighting with a muscular body, and will aim at the vital points of the opponent with its short horns. The fiery species of Padilla Cantera emits hot snorts. It uses the energy of fire to heat the Angle to 1000 degrees Celsius, and its enemies will suffer wounds and burns. Padilla Cantero of the Water Orchid species squirts water from the horn to swim. It also ejects water violently from holes in the tip of its horns to create a high-pressure stream of water to carry the enemy through.

Eudemon_Des_11678: The Cuddy dog is a small dog Pokemon. Its body color is orange, the snout, abdomen and tail are milky yellow, the back and limbs have black longitudinal stripes, and the head and neck have milky mane. The Cuddy dog has a short snout, a black nose, large round ears, two toes on the front and three toes on the back, and brown pads on the soles of the feet. The Cati dog, which can be seen in the Seri region, has longer body hair and more fur than the Cati dog that has been found so far. Because the body hair is soft and very warm, it can exercise energetically even in cold green areas. Under the influence of volcanic activity, the body hair mixed with igneous rock components. The horns, which are made of rock, are hard and sharp, but they are easily broken, so they seem to be used for attack only at critical moments.
Eudemon_Des_11679: Wind dogs are the Pokemon of large canines. It has fluffy flaxen-colored hair that covers its face. The eyes turn brown, the body has black and orange stripes like a tiger, the feet have hair around, and the tail has a long tail, and the body seems to merge with the wind when running, which is quite dignified. The wind dog looks like a stone lion. Its hair is grayish black, the hair on the top of the head forms a horn, a circle of hair around the neck like a petal spread out to the four sides, with red hair in the middle. It has an upward tail and hair on its feet.
Eudemon_Des_11680:
The Thunderball is a spherical Pokemon with no hands or feet. They look like a pixie ball with a face minus the buttons, with the top half red and the bottom half white. The green Thunderball is a round and shiny Pokemon. The structure of the body, which looks like wood grain, and the appearance features such as holes on the top of the head are similar to the fairy ball in the Chaochui area.
The Thunderball was discovered around the same time that the Fairy Ball was released, and was first discovered in the company that made the Fairy ball. It also shows up in places like power plants. Somehow its shape is similar to that of a Pixie ball, and the two are said to be related in some way, but the connection is still a mystery. Rumor has it that it was created by shining a powerful pulse at the Pixie Ball, and its resemblance to the Pixie Ball is actually its protective color. Many people will mistake it for a fairy ball to touch and be electrically numb, and sometimes even explode, which is very dangerous. It is an unidentified creature whose body composition has been investigated and found to be composed of substances that do not exist in nature. Surprisingly, it will explode immediately upon slight impact, and it is said that there have been incidents of jarring noise and sudden sPokemon-explosion. It moves by rolling over, and if the ground is uneven, it explodes on impact. Since a big explosion can occur at the slightest stimulus, even experienced trainers are cautious when using it.
Eudemon_Des_11681:
The shape of the naughty thunder ball is like an upside down fairy ball, red at the bottom and white at the top, and a mouth often shows a naughty smile. The Shicui naughty thunder projectile shows the body surface tissue like wood grain, the eye socket part is deeper, the whole looks like a carved wooden ball; The expression turned a little sad.
Naughty thunder bombs are popping up at power plants. Because it eats electricity, it causes blackouts and riots in nearby towns. It has the trait of being attracted to electricity and is a bunch of headaches. Because the body stores so much electrical energy that it is about to overflow, it will explode at the slightest stimulation. The more energy you store, the more you can move at higher speeds, but it's also more likely to explode. It will explode for fun when bored, very dangerous, with the nickname of bomb ball and fear. It also eats electricity from the air, and on days when thunder falls, naughty thunder bombs that eat too much electricity will explode everywhere. Sometimes there are naughty thunder bombs blowing in the wind, swollen from storing too much power.

The firestorm beast has become larger than before, and its flame has become fiercer, more like a circle of hair around its neck. The back of the firestorm beast is dark purple, and the flame around the neck has turned into a purple flame. The flame from the neck fire is up to 108 blobs, which will transform into a terrifying beast to attack the opponent.
When the heat around the Firebeast starts to shake, it's a sign that the battle is ready. It creates a heat wave with a searing flame to hide its shadow. It rubs against burning body hair and attacks with a fiery blast of gas that burns everything. When the fiery beast is so angry, it is so hot that it instantly ignites everything it touches.
Eudemon_Des_11683: The fish is like a round spiny fish, the eyes are raised, the mouth is pink, the back is dark green, the abdomen is light yellow, and the abdomen is clearly colored. It has a lot of hard spines on its body, and there are no other fins except the tail fin, which is shaped like a ghost. The small needles all over its body are made from scales. The back of the fish is black, the tip of the small needle and the mouth are purple, and the pattern on the tail fin is shaped like a letter "q".
Eudemon_Des_11684: 狃 Her body is predominantly black, her tail is red, her PAWS are silver-white, she has golden dots on her forehead and chest, and her left ear is red. It has sharp claws hidden in its fingers, which it will suddenly extend to frighten its attacker. Zicui 狃 her body is mainly silver with red eyes and purple on her left ear, tail, face, PAWS and middle body. There are sex differences between 狃 la and Zicui 狃 la, the female has shorter left ear. 狃 La lives in a cold place and has a cunning and ferocious character. They will hide in the dark to make themselves invisible, and rely on teamwork to attack prey at night. One is responsible for distracting the parents, the other is responsible for stealing the eggs, but also fights over who will eat them. It can climb trees by sticking hooks on its hands and feet into tree trunks, and steal Pokemon's eggs for food. He will cut a hole in the egg with his paw and suck the delicious food inside. Sometimes they are hated by their cultivators and banished. In the Arora region, they also prey on walruses. They are related to the 狃 that lives in the Zicui region, but their temperament is ruthless and cunning.
Eudemon_Des_11685:
The Great Sword Ghost is a four-legged blue sea beast. A long white beard extends from the muzzle of the head, which has a large beige round with spear-like spikes on the back of the head, with a helmet-like shell protruding sharply from the front. Its belly is covered with a bluish-gray shell-like carapace, its limbs are covered with cream-colored segmented wrist-like coverings, and it will fight with what appear to be forelimb armbands made of shells, known as foot blades. The shell is like a part of its body. The lower part of the wrist guard and the upper part and the spikes form the scabbard of the two swords and the hilt of the foot blade respectively. The Great Sword Ghost has three dark blue toes on each limb. It also has a fin-shaped eight-shaped tail, the innermost part of which is beige. Unlike the great sword ghosts found so far, the shells covered by the Great sword ghosts in the Sericui area turn dark blue and bend like layers of waves. The shell has a Burgundy pattern, and the toe, which is also Burgundy, reveals a hint of majesty. It also has a fin-shaped eight-shaped tail, but its innermost layer is dark blue.
Part of the big sword ghost's front foot armor is transformed into a huge sword, which attacks the enemy with a sword tucked in the armor, and can knock the opponent down with a single swing. It can stare at the enemy silence, roar can intimidate the enemy, can blink at the enemy with the double foot blade attached to the front foot of the moment to cut the opponent, and then withdraw it.
Compared to what has been found so far is the appearance of a dignified temperament, the appearance of the big sword ghost temperament and knife path are cruel and heartless, will do anything to win. Usually does not make a sound, very quiet, but as long as the enemy is close, it will use both feet to meet each other at lightning speed. In the battle, he is good at raiding and backstabbing and other tricky and cunning tactics. The angry waves unleashed by the bipedal blades are particularly prominent. The attack was like one big wave on top of another. It is said that after such an attack, the wound is difficult to heal for a long time afterwards.
Eudemon_Des_11686: On Lady Dress's head was a bright red flower with white spots on its petals, and the stamens were made up of golden filaments and red anthers, resembling a crown. Below the flowers there are long dark green leaves, and below them there are light green leaves, one of which drapes behind him like hair, and two of which hang loosely from the head. Its head and abdomen are white, and its eyes are bright red. It has long dark green leaves for arms, a golden calyx on the neck, and a pale green tulip-shaped leaf covering the lower body, as if wearing a skirt. Two long dark green leaves grew from its back and extended to the bottom of the "dress." Its feet are also made of golden calyx. Miss Skirt is only female, and there is no corresponding male Pokemon to pair with her. Miss Wash Dress looks like a ballerina. With a large pink flower on the head, two relatively large leaves cover the forehead and the rear, together with the small leaves under the flower and at the temples to form a short hair. The leaves in front of the body form a green skirt, and the neck is surrounded by four yellow flowers like a scarf. The long leaves of the arms are more slender than normal, while the "legs" of the lower body are more slender, with white and purple gradations, and the calyx of the foot looks like wearing yellow dancing shoes.
Eudemon_Des_11687: The Warrior Eagle is a large bird with a white crown of three feathers on its head and a reddish-brown base. There are three white feathers on each side of the cheeks and a tuft of white fuzz on the back of the neck. The overcoverts on the upper body and wings are reddish-brown, the chest, abdomen, legs and inner wings are navy blue, and the reddish-brown tail feathers end with a yellow band and a blue band. The beak and feet are yellow, and the upper beak has a curved protrusion at the end. The legs are stout, and the claws are huge, with four toes, three in front and one in back. There are long, curved claws at the top of the toes. The size of the Emerald Warrior eagle is larger than that of the warrior eagle found so far, and it is a big bird of courage. Its feathers are grayish-black, with white wing ends and tail feathers. The three crown feathers on the forehead are flame-like, the middle one is composed of purple and pale pink, and the two sides are composed of pale pink, purple and light blue, which are shaped like eyes. The Warrior Eagle is only male, and its female counterpart is Vulture Na.

Mucilage has a real shell.

The two tentacles are powerful enough to attack or grab an enemy and throw it out. There is mucus all over the body, and the hands and chin have the most concentrated and obvious mucus. It has a huge shell on its back that makes it look like a snail.
Eudemon_Des_11690: The ice rock monster resembles a turtle in appearance and form, and is made of icebergs. Its body looks like floating ice, and it mimics itsPokemon just by floating on the lake. The ice monster's legs are not ice, but brown rocks, and it has two large ice blades around its mouth.
Eudemon_Des_11691: It looks like it wears a big cape, but it's actually covered in a lot of feathers. Its feathers are green and its body is white.
