Eudemon_Des_11692: On the crown of the king's head is a large dark green bud shaped like a crown, with purple markings on the top of the bud. Several silver-gray antennae held the bud up to the smaller head. The tip of the head is silver and the chin is white. His blue eyes shone with majesty; Under the eyes is a petite blue nose and mouth. Its neck is shaped like a dark green pearl, arranged in a regular, from the outside to the inside color is blue, gray, white triangular pattern. Its arms are dark green and its hands are white. It has a pair of wings, the upper side of the wings is dark green, and the interior of the wings is still evenly distributed with blue, gray and white colors. Beneath the wings is its off-white body and slender, pure white legs.
Eudemon_Des_11693: On the crown of the king's head is a large dark green bud shaped like a crown, with purple markings on the top of the bud. Several silver-gray antennae held the bud up to the smaller head. The tip of the head is silver and the chin is white. His blue eyes shone with majesty; Under the eyes is a petite blue nose and mouth. Its neck is shaped like a dark green pearl, arranged in a regular, from the outside to the inside color is blue, gray, white triangular pattern. Its arms are dark green and its hands are white. It has a pair of wings, the upper side of the wings is dark green, and the interior of the wings is still evenly distributed with blue, gray and white colors. Beneath the wings is its off-white body and slender, pure white legs.
Eudemon_Des_16003: Venusaur is a squat, quadrupedal amphibian Pokémon with bumpy, blue-green skin. It has small, circular red eyes and a short, blunt snout. Its mouth is wide with two pointed teeth in the upper jaw and four in the lower jaw. On top of its head are small, pointed ears with reddish pink insides. It has three clawed toes on each foot. The bud on its back has bloomed into a large pink, white-spotted flower. The flower is supported by a thick, brown trunk surrounded by green fronds. A female Venusaur has a seed in the center of its flower.
Eudemon_Des_16006: As Mega Charizard X, its body and legs are more physically fit, though its arms remain thin. Its skin turns black with a sky-blue underside and soles. Two spikes with blue tips curve upward from the front and back of each shoulder, while the tips of its horns sharpen, turn blue, and curve slightly upward. Its brow and claws are larger, and its eyes are now red. It has two small, fin-like spikes under each horn and two more down its lower neck. The finger disappears from the wing membrane, and the lower edges are divided into large, rounded points. The third joint of each wing-arm is adorned with a claw-like spike. Mega Charizard X breathes blue flames out the sides of its mouth, and the flame on its tail now burns blue consistently. It is said that its new power turns it black and creates more intense flames.
Eudemon_Des_17006: As Mega Charizard Y, it becomes sleeker in appearance but retains its normal coloration. It has three pointed horns on the back of its head, the middle of which is longer. Its snout has larger fangs and a ridge on the nose. Its neck is shorter, but its torso is thinner and longer. It features longer digitigrade feet. Its hands are less developed, with extremely shortened fingers that are no longer separated from each other. Small wings develop on its wrists, while the ones on its back become larger, lose the wing finger passing through their membrane and end up with ragged edges. The back of its tail has a large spike at the base and three smaller ones near the tip, which now burns with a longer flame. Mega Charizard Y is said to have incredible flying prowess that is greater than a jet fighter.
Eudemon_Des_16009: When Mega Evolved, Blastoise develops two smaller shells over its arms, each with their own water cannon. The two cannons on its back are replaced by a single, central water cannon of greater size that can retract into its shell. This cannon extends forward over Mega Blastoise's head and is said to have a blast range of over 6 miles (10 kilometers). Small ridges develop over its now-red eyes and extend to its ears. The ears angle slightly backward and there is a small point on its chin.
Eudemon_Des_16065: As Mega Alakazam, its mustache turns white and becomes longer and bushier. It also grows a long, white beard. The armor-like sections become bulkier, and its upper body section becomes slightly shorter to reveal its thin stomach. The ear-like spikes become slightly shorter and a larger spike forms on top of its head. Additionally, it gains an oval, red organ in the center of its forehead. The organ is said to emit psychic power. Its lower legs become longer and slimmer and its feet become skinnier and resemble talons. It gains three additional spoons, for a total of five that it levitates in the air. At the cost of its already-low muscular strength, Mega Alakazam's power is entirely converted to pure psychic energy. It can read the course of a person's entire life with a single glance.
Eudemon_Des_16094:
As Mega Gengar, a portion of its body sinks into the ground and its arms and tail lengthen. The lower portions turn a more reddish-purple, and a third eye appears on its forehead. This new unblinking eye is oval, yellow, and allows it to see into other dimensions. The spikes on Mega Gengar's back are more numerous and pointed, and additional spikes appear on its hands and tail. Its ears are now considerably longer and tilt backward.
Mega Gengar has the ability to access other dimensions and has a vicious nature. Mega Gengar has no interest in opponents unless perceived as prey. Its relationships are warped due to Mega Evolution. It now desires to take and curse the life of anyone or anything in its path; it may even curse its own Trainer. Mega Gengar sinks into another dimension to wait for a chance to attack.
Eudemon_Des_16115: As Mega Kangaskhan, the mother Kangaskhan appears unchanged. However, the baby temporarily grows and gains some new features. There are now raised patches on its knees similar to those seen on its mother. These patches also appear aligned horizontally along its waist with a larger patch on its belly. Small, spiked growths appear underneath its ears. The child is feisty, hates to lose and will boldly challenge its opponents to protect its mother. The mother's happiness over its child's growth is the source of its additional strength. However, it feels uneasy about the child's future, as it is only skilled at fighting and nothing else. It is also saddened by the reminder that its child will one day leave.
Eudemon_Des_16127:
As Mega Pinsir, it gains a large pair of clear, yellow wings with an area of orange venation near the base. Additionally, a set of brown elytra appear. Slicing through each elytron is a pair of orange blades. Its arms become longer and it has a T-shaped spike on each forearm. The pincers on its head are now longer with larger spikes, and its eyes are now yellow.
When it Mega Evolves, Pinsir is left in a constant state of excitement. It rarely touches the ground due to its ability to now fly. Mega Pinsir can travel up to approximately 30 mph (50 km/h) and uses its two large horns to pierce its enemies before shredding them. Mega Pinsir can lift opponents up to 10 times heavier than itsPokemon with its horns and still fly around easily.
Eudemon_Des_16130:
When it Mega Evolves, Gyarados becomes bulkier. The fins on its cheeks become longer and gain a yellow tint. Its crest is larger and black, and its barbels also gain considerable length. A large spike extends downward underneath its chin, and it now has a black underside with a red stripe around the edges. The yellow spots along its body are replaced by raised red scales, which propel Mega Gyarados through the water. Two large yellow fins with blue spines appear on its back. Most of the other fins along its back disappear, replaced by two rows of blue spikes. There are now four yellowish, spiky fins near its tail: two on its back and two on its underside.
Due the stress Mega Evolution puts on a Gyarados's body, it becomes even more ferocious than before. All other brain functions cease when Mega Evolution occurs, except for the destructive drive to burn down anything into cinders. Despite its brain having a powerful destructive instinct, it will obey a Trainer it truly trusts. Mega Gyarados can launch at Mach Speed by using its orifices to release water from both sides. With this speed, it has enough power to split large ships in two. Mega Gyarados is tied with Hoopa Unbound as the tallest Dark-type.
Eudemon_Des_16142: As Mega Aerodactyl, its eyes turn bright green and parts of its body turn to stone, which some researchers believe to be its original appearance before fossilization. It grows larger and sprouts jagged black spiky rocks all over its body: five spikes at the wrist joint of each wing replacing its hands, three small spikes along its tail, one spike on each ear, and a long spike on its chin. The spike on its back and its rear talons have also become black and stony. Rocky plates cover its eyebrows and the corners of its jaw. Similar stone ornaments are present on its chest on its torso: two small ridges flanking a longer ridge.
Eudemon_Des_16150: Mega Mewtwo X is larger and bulkier than its normal state. The horns on its head are longer and extend from V-shaped ridges on its forehead. Additionally, the horns are now pointed and curve upward. It now has two tubes behind its neck, its eyes are light blue, and it has large, purple growths over its shoulders. Its torso is smooth and small compared to its long, bulky limbs, and a Y-shaped line connects the collar and underbelly. Its forearms and thighs each have two raised ridges and its digits are now longer and thinner. Its tail is slightly shorter and stiffer than before and has a curled tip. Its muscles are augmented with psychic power, giving it a grip strength of one ton and the ability to sprint 100 meters in two seconds. When using moves in battle, it is shown to be able to stretch its arms and legs.
Eudemon_Des_17150: Mega Mewtwo Y is smaller and lighter, losing its long tail and the tube behind its neck. However, it grows a long, purple appendage with a curled tip from the back of its head that is similar to its previous form's tail. On its head, it has two pointed, backward-curving spikes and a half-ring structure connecting to the base of each and crossing over the top of its head. Its eyes are now red and slightly larger. The digits on its hands and feet are now purple and more bulbous and the middle toe is longer than the others. A bumpy ridge similar to a sternum replaces the breastplate structure on its chest, but this form is still largely smoother than the other two. Despite its decreased size, it has phenomenal mental power and is capable of smashing buildings with a mere thought.
Eudemon_Des_16181: As Mega Ampharos, its toes turn black and it regrows white wool at the back of its head and over its tail, having its genes stimulated by Mega Evolution. This energy also awakens its long-sleeping dragon blood. Its long wooly tail has many small, red orbs attached to it. Its conical ears retain their stripes but are now segmented with swirled tips. When it increases the amount of electrical energy within itsPokemon, the red orbs on its body and wool emit a strong light.
Eudemon_Des_16212: Mega Scizor's pincers lengthen and develop serrations. The lower half of the pincers turn white and gain three-pointed spikes on the underside. The barbs on Mega Scizor's pincers can stab through concrete, and opponents caught in them cannot escape. Its eyespots, along with its actual eyes, are now blue; the former additionally gains a black rim. Additional pieces of black armoring appear on various areas of its body: a three-pointed crest on its forehead and striated coverings on its shoulders and thighs. Mega Scizor's legs are less detailed and resemble large, tapered spikes with white tips.
Eudemon_Des_16214: Mega Heracross is bulkier than its previous form. Thin orange markings now rim its head, hands, and shoulders. Additionally, there is a half-circle, orange marking over its eyes. It now has a long, pointed nose that curves slightly upward. Its back now lacks wings and is completely yellow. The horn on its head has grown into a large, simple spike with two smaller spikes on the front. The antennae have lengthened as well and now have ovoid tips. Mega Heracross's forearms have thickened and lost their spines.
Eudemon_Des_16229: As Mega Houndoom, the ridges on its back thicken, and it gains additional bone-like rings around the base of its tail. The rings on its tail have small spikes on top resembling vertebrae. The ridge at the base of Mega Houndoom's neck is longer and curves forward towards its shoulders. Instead of a band with a skull pendant, there is a large, toothed structure around its neck. This bone-like formation has two large spikes on either side and three pointed teeth on the bottom. Mega Houndoom's horns now point straight up with a small, outward curve in the middle. The two bands on its hind legs have vanished, and those on its forelegs are broken in the front.
Eudemon_Des_16248: Mega Tyranitar has more gaps in its armor than its normal form, with four new triangular holes along the sides of its neck and one on its throat. The four holes on its chest are now larger with the top two containing red ovals. While the spikes along the back of its neck grow shorter, the ones on its head elongate to form prominent ridges along its brows. The center spike on its head becomes a long, upright horn. Its chest plate expands, curving over its shoulders and along its back to form three long, irregular spikes on each side of its body. The scales on Mega Tyranitar's belly have now become red instead of blue and seethe with energy, enabling it to emanate more power. It gains two sharp spikes on its knees, as well as more prominent leg joints. Its tail lengthens, with the three spikes surrounding its tip growing upward and outward. Its back had split open because of the overwhelming power from Mega Evolution. As a Mega Tyranitar, its instincts have only become more destructive, to the point where it may not even be able to hear its Trainer's orders.
Eudemon_Des_16257: As Mega Blaziken, it loses its yellow markings and gains black markings on its upper legs and chest. Its hair-like feathers take on a wing-like shape and point upward, and the portion around its chest is rough around its shoulders. The crest on its head changes into a flat horn that curves backward. The fire it creates on its wrists is now longer. When Blaziken Mega Evolves into Mega Blaziken, it further hones the power of its kicks, always a source of pride to it. As it unleashes a flurry of savage kicks, its legs can begin to burn from the friction of the surrounding atmosphere. As Mega Blaziken's body temperature increases, its power and speed continue to ramp up.
Eudemon_Des_16282:
As Mega Gardevoir, it turns almost completely white; only its hair remains green. Its gown becomes longer and wider, resembling a bridal gown. The forearms are slightly thicker with a pointed extension above the elbow, resembling gloves. Its facial spikes are larger and now curl upwards. In contrast, its hair is now shorter and more tightly curled. There are now two horns in the center of its chest, extending to either side.
These horns are said to be a physical manifestation of this Pokémon's heart, and it is able to use tremendous psychic power now that it is open. Iron Valiant bares a resemblance to Mega Gardevoir. Iron Valiant bares a resemblance to a combined Mega Gardevoir and Mega Gallade.
Eudemon_Des_16303: Mega Mawile has two sets of jaws protruding from the back of its head, and both sets have a spiky tuft of hair. It also seems to be able to control the jaws independently of one another. The ear-like extensions on its head are longer and have tips with two points. Its legs have grown longer, and its "hakama" is now magenta. Its arms now resemble thick sleeves, with magenta markings around the wrists. Mega Mawile can use both its jaws to grip on prey and tear them apart. These jaws thrash around violently.
Eudemon_Des_16306: Mega Aggron is bulkier and more heavily plated than its previous state. The horns on its forehead are now shorter, and it has a third, wider horn on its nose. Using its horns, it is said to be able to destroy a steel tank. A spike projects downward from both its upper and lower jaw. The protrusions on its shoulders are longer and curve toward its head, and new spikes thrust from holes in its armbands. Its tail is thicker with two bands around it.
Eudemon_Des_16308: As Mega Medicham, its headpiece now resembles a white turban with a yellow stone in the center. The red extension in the back is retained, and there are five white extensions on the turban, three extending from the stone and one on either side of its head. There is now a gold band on each wrist and additional gold bands around its waist. Several blue, teardrop-shaped decorations hang from the lowest hip band. Using its enhanced willpower, Mega Medicham has formed four ghost-like arms around itsPokemon. The more trained its spirit, the more realistic and dexterous its sPokemon-created arms become.
Eudemon_Des_16310:
The yellow mane on Mega Manectric is considerably larger than its previous state. The center spike on its head has shifted, and now forms a large, tilted growth that extends over its snout and has a point on either end. The remaining two head spikes are thinner, longer, and have small, pointed bulbs in place of the earholes. The mane now extends down the length of Mega Manectric's body, forming four additional spikes. One of these spikes extends down past the Pokémon's chest and has points on both ends. The tufts of fur on its haunches are now blue and form more numerous, thinner points. While it retains the yellow tufts around its front feet, they now have two short spikes extending backward. Finally, Mega Manectric lacks the sharply angled tail of its previous state and now has red claws.
When it Mega Evolves, its speed is explosive and is equal to a lightning bolt. However, its body becomes filled with such an incredible amount of electricity that Manectric is unable to fully control it all, thereby irritating it.
Eudemon_Des_16354:
As Mega Banette, this Pokémon gains several additional zippers: one running diagonally across its face, one on each hand, and another on its body. The first zipper runs from its left eye to the tip of its central spike. The other three are all unzipped, revealing parts of Mega Banette's cursed purple body. Its three long purple fingers and body revealing two pointed, purple legs are visible. Its zigzagging ribbon becomes somewhat erect, and now has two zipper rings around it and a short zipper on the tip. It gains four further spikes: one on the top and bottom of each hand and one on each hip. However, it loses its brush-like tail.
When it Mega Evolves, it is filled with so much power and vindictiveness it cannot help cursing its Trainer.
Eudemon_Des_16359:
As Mega Absol, its fur is longer overall, and the increased energy coursing through its body makes the fur at the back of its mane stand on end so that it appears to have wings. The spikes on its heels and elbows grow larger, and the fur in these areas becomes longer as well. Its sickle-shaped horn widens, while an additional, smaller horn appears on the opposite side of its head. Its tail now has a more saw-like shape, and the oval marking on its forehead is now a rounded triangle.
Mega Absol emits a fearsome aura that has been known to kill fainthearted people from shock. It directs this aura at its opponents by beating its "wings", which are not capable of flight. However, Absol apparently detests assuming this form, as it normally dislikes fighting in the first place.
Eudemon_Des_16380: As Mega Latias, the red parts of its body change to purple. Horns grow from the side of its head and run along its jaw. It loses the wings on its back and similar but larger wings attach to its lower arms, normally held in a level position. Triangle shapes now mark the forward point of its wings instead of its chest.
Eudemon_Des_16381: As Mega Latios, the blue parts of its body change to purple. Horns grow from the side of its head and run along its jaw. It loses the wings on its back and similar but larger wings attach to its lower arms, normally held in a level position. Triangle shapes now mark the forward point of its wings instead of its chest.
Eudemon_Des_16445: When Garchomp Mega Evolves, several of its features become more angular, including its head and shoulders. A row of five tooth-like spikes sprouts from each side of its abdomen and red spikes grow from its knees. The claws and fins on its arms melt from the excessive Mega Evolution energy and morph together to form sharp, red blades. Because Garchomp takes great pride in its winglike fins, it is enraged at the sight of them melting into scythes. Its scythes can slice the ground to pieces, and Mega Garchomp viciously tears up its opponents with them.
Eudemon_Des_16448: As Mega Lucario, its cream fur becomes longer, and its thighs slim down. It develops more spikes on the back of its paws, which have turned crimson. It also develops spikes on both of its feet, which have become crimson too. Its previously red eyes are now orange-colored. Its aura-sensing appendages grow longer, and two of them are tipped in crimson. Its shoulders also possess a spike each. Its aura heightens throughout its body, which formed black markings on its blue fur.
Eudemon_Des_16460: The sprouts on its back grow into great shafts of ice when this Pokémon Mega Evolves into Mega Abomasnow. Its fur becomes longer and shaggy over its entire body, particularly around its head. Green fur or sprout remnants surround the base of the large icicles on its back, while white fur covers the middle.
Eudemon_Des_16015: As Mega Beedrill, it gains more defined features. The antennae are shorter and T-shaped. Its eyes become longer and sleeker. It now has three pairs of wings; the uppermost pair is larger with black trim along the top. Its stingers become longer and larger, resembling lances. Additional conical, black-and-yellow stingers with white tips take the place of its legs. Its abdomen becomes larger, grooved, and is attached to its thorax by a black structure. A similar black structure connects its head and thorax. The stinger on its abdomen is now a pale yellow, and it now has black stripes over its entire body. Fast-acting poison is stored in the stingers on its limbs, while the tail stinger produces a slow-acting poison that is used to finish opponents. The instantaneous poisons are instead used to prevent the foe from fleeing.
Eudemon_Des_16018: Pidgeot grows noticeably when it Mega Evolves, developing a larger body and longer, broader wings. Its wingtips and tail feathers are tipped with cyan, and its cream coloring is now white. Its eyes turn magenta and its pupils turn white. Mega Pidgeot has an even more elaborate crest on its head, with a streamer-like magenta plume extending from a mane of yellow feathers. A magenta feather projects from the front of its crest and there is a single magenta highlight on the left side. The crest is sensitive to air currents, acting like a large antenna and stabilizing Mega Pidgeot's flight. Additionally, its increased wing power allows it to fly for two weeks without rest.
Eudemon_Des_16080: As Mega Slowbro, it becomes engulfed by the Shellder so that only its head, arms, and white-tipped tail are visible. Its head pokes out of the Shellder's mouth and is surrounded by the Shellder's enlarged teeth. The Shellder has holes on its sides and an opening at its tip, allowing Mega Slowbro's arms and tail to stick out. Mega Slowbro balances on its tail due to its legs being engulfed. It can move by bouncing, using its tail as a spring. The spikes on the Shellder are now reduced to four on the bottom section of its body and the dark spots only visible on its middle section. Mega Slowbro's energy has gathered into Shellder, which has increased its hardness. This allows it to act as armor so hard that nothing can scratch it. The Slowbro inside is virtually unchanged, but it gains some power and motivation from Shellder's digestive fluids.
Eudemon_Des_16208: As Mega Steelix, its body becomes longer, almost doubles its mass, and gains more features. Mega Steelix's eyes turn blue and its lower jaw becomes more heavily armored with a round, curved shape. Additionally, a third pair of ridges appear on its bottom jaw, as well as two sharp, flat structures consisting of three conjoined projections on each side. The gray, rock-like spikes and its tail point have transformed into prism-like crystalline spikes; the segments from which the spikes protrude are much larger as well. In-between the head and individual spiked segments are smaller units, now adorned by a black spot with a blue hexagon on each side. Several metallic-looking scraps constantly rotate around its neck; these scraps react to Mega Steelix's movements and change position when attacking. The cells within its body, crystallized by the energy produced from Mega Evolution, are stronger than any mineral and able to withstand any temperature. It moves incredibly slowly, but its strengthened body is also impervious to damage, and it lashes out at foes without flinching.
Eudemon_Des_16254:
As Mega Sceptile, its head crests become more pointed with a round portion missing from the middle. Red marking surrounds its eyes, which become smaller and more narrow. The yellow seeds down its back grow larger. The last pair of seeds turn red, while the pair above it turns orange. Red stripes encircle the base of its tail and run across its lower belly. The leaves on its wrists become more pointed, and the upper ones have red tips and half-circles cut out of the middles. Covering its chest and shoulders are plates of leaves similar to those that form its tail. Mega Sceptile's tail grows longer and develops a red stinger at the tip.
Mega Sceptile can cut off a portion of its tail to fire it like a missile at an opponent. Its lost tail will continue regenerating as long as it still has the energy required for Mega Evolution.
Eudemon_Des_16260: As Mega Swampert, this Pokémon gains considerable bulk. Its upper body and arms become more muscular, bulging compared to its squat lower body. The orange padding on Swampert's thighs vanish, but it gains two additional patches of orange padding on each wrist and another patch on each shoulder. This padding and its gills become a darker, redder shade of orange, while the gills are now larger and bulbous, with filaments extending past its mouth. The black fins on its head are thicker and now extend down past its shoulders. The black tail fin is still shaped like an upward-turned fan, but it now forms a short ridge that extends up to this Pokémon's forehead, flanked on either side by the aforementioned head-fins. The webbed digits on Mega Swampert's "hands" take on a black color and now feature better defined articulations. According to the anime, Mega Swampert fills the organs on its back with air before diving underwater or battling; it uses that pressure to increase the power of its punches.
Eudemon_Des_16302: As Mega Sableye, being bathed in Mega Evolution energy causes the red jewel on its chest to rip out of Sableye's skin and significantly increase in size; the detached jewel leaves a small hole in Mega Sableye's chest. Its ears elongate, and it gains a spike on the top of its head. Its teeth turn from white to yellow, and its eyes also change from pale blue to a crimson red, with diagonal slits at their inner edges. Its back gains more gems: a second green one, a second red one, and two small yellow gems.
Eudemon_Des_16319: As Mega Sharpedo the fangs in its mouth have transformed, and the horns that have sprouted from its nose are fangs that are retractable, and can be regrown countless times. The yellow patterns on its body are old resurfaced scars that were carved in battle, causing it sharp pain and suffering. With explosive propulsion, it can exceed 125 mph in an instant. Its combat instinct were increased due to Mega Evolution. Mega Sharpedo's sharp spikes can cause deep wounds to its opponents after charging at them.
Eudemon_Des_16323: As Mega Camerupt, the humps on its back have transformed into one large and very active volcano. Its fur expands and grows to a point where only its hooves can be seen, and its ears and the tufts on its head grow thicker and longer, standing on end. It gains a gray M on the front of its face and loses the three blue rings on its body. Magma is constantly bubbling up from within its body. It has a deep hatred of water or any moisture, with an explosive personality, and a short temper. The volcano on its back erupts constantly in an effort to intimidate its foes.
Eudemon_Des_16334: Mega Altaria has more extensive cloud-like plumage, with a large, fluffy mass extending from its back. The feathers have grown as a sPokemon-protective measure, and they glimmer with an iridescent sheen. Its cottony wings are more distinct than in its base form, and its blue belly is now exposed. Additional fluff surrounds its neck like a collar, and its head is adorned with a hat-like crest. A single, small feather curls out from its forehead, though its facial features are unchanged. Its tail feathers have grown into a long, wavy streamer, with three longer central plumes. Mega Altaria's singing voice is even more beautiful than that of its regular form. It is known for its sociable personality and is not timid.
Eudemon_Des_16362:
Mega Glalie's jaw is dislocated because of the overwhelming energy, causing its mouth to extend to the length of its face. The lower jaw is all black except for two light-blue, conical, icy spikes. The pupils in Mega Glalie's eyes are now red instead of black. The horns on top Mega Glalie's head have been partially turned into ice, with the addition of a third horn on its forehead.
Mega Glalie can spill endless blizzards from its broken mouth, though it gets irritated by the fact that it can no longer consume its prey. The areas Mega Glalie often appears in, will cause the area to be whited out. Any prey that it envelopes within its mouth is frozen instantly.
Eudemon_Des_16373: As Mega Salamence, its wings meld together into a single huge, crescent-shaped wing. According to the anime, the hard, yet very flexible properties of its wings allow them to be used as blades in mid-air battles. Its face, neck, body and tail are narrower, and its tail is noticeably shorter in length. The ridges above its eyes are now far less prominent, and it no longer possesses the thick, gray scaling over its lower jaw. Instead, the smooth red flesh underneath has been left exposed, increasing its streamline appearance. The upper pair of fins resting on the sides of its head are now elongated and tapered. The lower pair has not changed much. However, the middle set now take the form of quarter-arches, spanning towards the bridge of the nose. The remnants of its shelled underbelly have been drastically transformed into a segmented, more aerodynamic, vest-like armored frame. This frame encases its chest and shoulders with the pieces interlocking whenever Mega Salamence tucks in its front forelegs. Roaring Moon bears a resemblance to Mega Salamence, though the potential connection between the two is unknown.
Eudemon_Des_16376:
As Mega Metagross, it constantly floats, and its legs become arms. It also gains four legs on the back of its head. The cross on its face turns pale gold, and it gains two small holes and a spike immediately below the cross, giving the impression of a goatee.
Mega Metagross achieves its form by linking up a Metagross, a Metang, and two Beldum together. Its multiple brains process information simultaneously, enabling it to calmly assess the tide of a battle and defeat its opponent with accuracy. Mega Metagross also uses the psychic power inside its body to launch powerful attacks. Its claws are hard as steel and can easily smash even large chunks of rocks. Because Mega Evolution stimulates its multiple brains and increases its intelligence, Mega Metagross becomes a ruthless combatant that will clutch at victory by absolutely any means, no matter how horrifyingly cruel. If victory is deemed impossible, Metagross will attempt to dig its claws into its opponent and prepare to explode.
Eudemon_Des_16384: Mega Rayquaza releases particles from the long tentacles extending from its chest. These particles can control gas concentration and humidity, and manipulate them all
Eudemon_Des_16428: As Mega Lopunny, its personality drastically changes, becoming extremely aggressive with wild fighting instincts. In order to become more capable of fighting, it sheds the fur on its neck, upper torso, fingers, and legs, forming black patterns on the legs that resembles ripped pantyhose. The tufts of fur above its eyes combine to form a single butterfly-shaped crest. The cream fur on its wrists and ankles becomes more round instead of fluffy. Its ear fur now only covers two segments of each ear in fluffy bands. When Mega Evolved, a full-power whip swing from its ears can crumple steel plates.
Eudemon_Des_16475:
As Mega Gallade, its entire body becomes white, save for its head. Red plates emerge from its arms, its blue head crest grows slightly longer, and the spikes on its head are elongated. It also gains two cape-like protrusions on its back, giving it a knightly appearance.
When the situation demands it, Mega Gallade can use its psychic power to reshape both arms into blades simultaneously and fight using a dual-wielding style. Iron Valiant bears a resemblance to a combined Mega Gallade and Mega Gardevoir.

White fur covers its feet with two small tufts on the heels. Eudemon_Des_16719: As Mega Diancie, its white dress becomes longer and loses its sleeves. Eudemon_Des_17628:
Superdream resembles a humanoid and feline, with a silver-white body, purple eyes, tail, and belly, an external nerve bundle extending from the center of the back to the back of the neck, and three spherical fingers. Super Super Dream X after super evolution added "hood", "football equipment" and other elements. Super Super Dream Y's body has become smaller and more like a "baby", with a "earpiece" protruding on the enlarged head.
Super dream is a treasure dream created by recombining the genetic gene of dream, although the gene of super dream is almost exactly the same as dream, but the size and personality are very different. It is said to have the cruelest heart of all Pokemon's dreams. Human science can create its body, but can not create a gentle heart. Now it is said to be sleeping deep in a cave somewhere.
Super Super Dream X's muscles on the body are enhanced by mental strength. It has a grip strength of 1 ton. You can run 100 meters in 2 seconds. Although Super Super Dream Y's body is smaller, its strength is too large to calculate. With the slightest use of the power of thought, even tall buildings will be reduced to ashes.
Eudemon_Des_16888:
Cang Ring is the legendary Pokemon of the Galar region. As the heroes of the legend, Cangxiang and Zangmaranth appear in the legend and are passed down from generation to generation. It is believed to be the elder sister of the long-sleeping Zangmaranth, but it is also believed that they are bitter rivals.
Cang is a Pokemon full of mysteries. Its appearance is similar to that of some dogs in the real world. One of its ears looks like a piece is missing, the mane of the whole body is hanging down, most of the fur color is blue, and the white pattern on the body looks like a scar. Its ears are also connected to parts similar to braids, and its limbs are relatively long and narrow. It absorbs metal and turns it into a weapon to fight. If you carry a rotten sword with props to Cang Ring, then Cang Ring will change from the form of a brave warrior to the form of a king of swords. In the form of the king of swords, the Changhung holds something like a sword in his mouth, and the patterns on his body become rich and varied and very colorful. It will use the sword in its mouth to attack opponents, this sword can cut everything in the world, so it is called the sword of the fairy king. This sword is so sharp that even the heavy scales of the dragon Pokemon can be cut like paper, leaving friends and foes in awe.
The sword king Cang will be like the wind shuttling through the battlefield to fight the enemy. The manner is magnificent and beautiful, so it is also likened to its posture "as if it were dancing." Its blows are too fast to be caught by the naked eye, and after being hit by its sword, it will fall without feeling any pain, even the super Giant Pokemon can take it down with a sword. It will use the monster chop, by enlarging the sword it holds in its mouth, aiming and chopping at its opponent. This move in particular has a powerful effect on the powers possessed by the Super Pokemon, and the impact will penetrate the opponent's super body, dealing the opponent near-death damage. It's even thought to be destructive enough to cut the ocean in half.
Eudemon_Des_16889:
Zangmarant is the legendary Pokemon of the Galar region. As the heroes of the legend, Zangmarante and Cangxiang appear in the legend and are passed down from generation to generation. It once stopped the dark night together with Cang Xiang, thus saving the Galar region, so it is known as a legendary hero, feared and revered by people. After working with the King of all to save the Pokemon of Galar, he fell into a long sleep as a stone statue, almost forgotten by the people, even in the Galar region, few people know about their existence.
Zangmarant is a Pokemon full of mysteries. When Zangmarante did not become the king of the shield, his appearance was more ordinary dog appearance, one of his ears seemed to be missing a piece, with a strand of hair turned up, and the edges and corners of his body were more distinct than that of Cang Xiang. Like Cang Xiang, his body was covered with patterns similar to wounds. His whole body looked like he was wearing sharp armor, and his limbs were relatively long and narrow. The shape of the face looks like a little shield. It fights by absorbing metal. If you give Zangmaranth a rotten shield, then Zangmaranth will be transformed into a shield King form, this form's body is covered with a shield-like object. Zangmaranth will use a metal shield covering the surface of his body to defend against attacks by his opponents. The shield is so strong that it can bounce off any attack, so it is called the Shield of the Fighting King, even the sharp claws of the dragon Pokemon can not leave any scratches on it.
No matter how brutal the battlefield is fearless, the shield king Zangmarant will proudly break into the enemy camp to fight the enemy. It is heavily armed and can easily resist even the most powerful Pokemon attacks. The shield-like armor is both an iron-walled defense and a powerful means of attack. It is said that the force of its thrust is enough to crack the earth, and the shock wave generated at the same time can knock down hundreds of enemies. It is capable of using monster shells, which have a powerful effect on the powers possessed by the Super Giant Pokemon by making the fan armor giant slam into opponents. The impact of the move will penetrate the opponent's extremely large body, giving the opponent near-death damage. It is even thought to be destructive enough to penetrate the majestic mountains.
Eudemon_Des_16658: Rana kaghe is a kind of bipedal frog. The body and legs are dark blue, the chest is yellow; There are white bubbles on each limb, and a four-pointed star mark on each leg, which looks like a sword in the hand; The forelimbs have three fingers, the hind limbs have two fingers, and the feet are webbed; The lower parts of the face and pointed ears are pale yellow; There are white spots above the eyes, and the eyes have white sclera, red iris and white pupil; The pink scarf around its neck is its tongue.
Eudemon_Des_16483:
Emperor Luca appears to be a dark blue sauropods with metallic parts and several light blue stripes. Its head has a square tapered top, and pale blue stripes extend from the tip of the cone to the neck of Luca the Emperor. It has two horns on its head, which are on either side of its body, each extending down to a protrusion over its eyes, and the two horns reaching to its mouth. The legendary Pokemon has dark gray eyelids with barely visible sclera, a red iris, and black pupils. There are three black lines on the left and right sides of the nose, and the bridge of the nose is silver-white metal. It has a pink tongue with a silver-white lower lip and two white sharp conical fangs, but no upper lip. The metal part of his chest, like his natural breastplate, is set with a cobalt blue pentagonal diamond in the center, the emperor Luca has three silver spines on his neck, and a fish-like structure with five spines on his back. It has a tail and four feet, each with three metal claws.
The body of the Emperor tooth Luca in its origin form is dark blue with a hammer-like neck. It has a fan-shaped structure on its back with five silver-white protrusions. The front leg has a spine on the joint and has three silver claws, while the hind legs have no claws. Its body is surrounded by a ring of thorns.
Luca has the ability to control time and is known as the God of Time. It can warp time to speed it up or slow it down or even stop it. With the birth of Tega Luka, time began to flow. When Tega Luka's heart beats, time passes. It has the power to manipulate time, manipulating the flow of time itsPokemon so that it can move into the past and future. Legend has it that when Teja Luka was born, earthly time began to flow like a mighty river. Emperor Luca exists in a different dimension, is fiercely protective of his territory, and shows no mercy to Palucia, and their meeting could cause serious violence.
The origin of the form of the Emperor Luca, which resembles the posture of the creator God, is the original appearance of the Emperor Luca, and light is the fuse that promotes the change of the form. It has the power to warp, destroy and regenerate time. It is said to exist in a world where the direction of the flow of time is constantly changing and its speed is not fixed. It excels at a move known as the roar of time, which is powerful enough to warp time.
Eudemon_Des_16484:
Palucia is a lilac, theropod Pokemon with purple-black stripes and a gray inner arm. At its shoulders are discs with purple stripes, each with a pearl embedded in them, each surrounded by a gray ring. Palucia's arms have elongated structures that resemble metal gloves, with a purple band on each wrist. Palucia has a long neck, a pointed crown on its head that extends to its wings, two ivory horns near its beak, and a stout tail.
The Palucia of origin resembled a centaur, with a horsetail tail and very strong hind legs. The head is like a knight's helmet, the purple ring at the waist undates, and the shoulder disc is connected to the wings at the back.
Palucia has the ability to warp space and is described as a god in the mythology of the Shenao region. It can manipulate spatial connections by itsPokemon so that it can move to distant different Spaces. With each breath Palucia takes, the space becomes more settled. There is a myth in the Zacui area that when this God was born, the barrier between the present world disappeared and endless space appeared. It is said that Palucia lived in parallel slits of space, had a strong territorial sense, and would have violent conflicts with the emperor Luca.
The original form of Palucia is the original form of Palucia, and imitating the image of the Creator is the way to make his power your own. Its soaring posture is reminiscent of the creator of all things. It has the power to distort, destroy and regenerate space. It is said that in the world in which it exists, space is torn apart. It specializes in a powerful move known as the subair Split, whose attack will tear the opponent apart along with the surrounding space.
Eudemon_Des_16487:
Riding Ladina is a large, gray, dragon-like Pokemon with a golden half-ring around its neck from its back. The black and red stripes are horizontal on the front of the neck. It has two large ghost-like wings with red structures like claws at the tips. This pair of wings can change shape like a liquid or gas. Riding Ladina has six stout legs with claws at the end. Origin form Riding Ladina takes on a polychaete posture similar to that of annelida. Its wings became six ghostly, banded wings that floated behind it, with red tips. Its legs retracted into golden spikes, and four more spikes appeared near the end of its tail.
It is said that Riding Ladina was banished because of his violent character, and inhabited a ruined world without heaven and earth on the back side of this world, where all the conventions were different from this world. It stayed in the destroyed world, quietly watching the original world, sometimes appearing in ancient cemeteries. There is an old saying in the Zicui area: strong light and dark shadow. The shadow may refer to a different form of riding Ladina.
Eudemon_Des_16890:
Eternatus is a gigantic, draconic alien Pokémon. Its body has a vaguely draconic shape and a skeletal appearance, and is largely dark violet with red highlights. Its main body and tail are long, thin, and resemble a spinal column, and it has four small, thin limbs ending in claws formed from spindly appendages attached at right angles. Its torso is formed from a cage of appendages resembling ribs, and inside is a glowing pink core that serves as Eternatus's energy source, absorbing energy to sustain it. The core can also project its absorbed energy into massive blasts when using Dynamax Cannon, one of its signature moves. Its head is triangular in shape and has a pair of white, eye-like markings in the form of three connected circles, as well as a spindly lower jaw with several diamond-shaped teeth. Over its head is a translucent red film held between five long spikes extending toward its body's rear. It also has a pair of thin tendrils extending from its back, formed from numerous triangular segments. Eternatus's gigantic size makes it the tallest known Pokémon to ever exist.
Eternatus serves as the source of the Dynamax and Gigantamax phenomena in Galar due to its power leaking out in the form of Galar Particles following its defeat thousands of years ago by Zacian and Zamazenta. Pieces of its body imbued with its power rain down throughout Galar in the form of Wishing Pieces and Wishing Stars. When it is awake, Eternatus causes a phenomenon dubbed the Darkest Day, in which the massive quantities of Dynamax energy it unleashes causes Pokémon to Dynamax and rampage uncontrollably. It can also sometimes keep other Pokémon from Dynamaxing in its presence. Despite this connection to the phenomenon, it cannot be Dynamaxed itself, as its Eternamax form replaces that effect. Eternatus has been referred to as the Darkest Day.
As seen in the anime, Eternatus can use its energy core to target a Pokémon and force it to Dynamax or Gigantamax. The anime also elaborates upon its ability to block other Pokémon from Dynamaxing, depicting this power as Eternatus absorbing the Galar Particles in the area to make them unavailable for other Pokémon to use. It is also shown to be capable of forcibly reverting other Pokémon that have already Dynamaxed or Gigantamaxed through the same process. As seen in the Pokémon Adventures Manga, its Poison also has the capability of changing someone's behavior, making them violent and selfish, as shown with Henry after he touched some of Eternatus's poison. According to Rose in the anime, he was the one to have coined Eternatus’s name.
Eternatus is an extraterrestrial Pokémon that came to Earth inside a meteor around 20,000 years ago.
Eternatus is the only known Pokémon capable of learning the moves Dynamax Cannon and Eternabeam. In Generation IX, Cross Poison is also one of its signature moves.

MapArea_Name_2352: The rock field by the water
MapMini_Des_1101: A quiet town surrounded by tree-lined forests and lush grasslands where Pokemons roam freely.
MapMini_Des_1102: A thriving city, full of high-rise buildings and traffic, with many power facilities and Pokemon trainers clustered here.
MapMini_Des_1103: A grey city that feels oppressive and insecure, with a black market and a stronghold for criminal groups, Pokemon has become murderous and dangerous.
MapMini_Des_1104: A beautiful coastal city with sunny, fresh sea breezes, many aquariums and seafood restaurants where people and Pokemon can have fun.
MapMini_Des_1105: A seasonal city. In autumn, the leaves fall and the bleak atmosphere fills the city. There is the Zerg Pavilion and the Insect-like Pokemon competition.
MapMini_Des_1106: A mysterious town, surrounded by purple flowers and quiet atmosphere, there are many super power trainers and Pokemon.
MapMini_Des_1107: Yuhong City is a thriving commercial center with a variety of shops and markets where you can buy all kinds of Pokemon supplies and props.
MapMini_Des_1108: A city dominated by commerce, the large shopping mall in the city center attracts many merchants and consumers.
MapMini_Des_1109: A sports-oriented city, with many sports venues and competition venues, attracting many athletes and enthusiasts to come.
MapMini_Des_1110: A nature-oriented town with a beautiful lotus pond in the center, surrounded by lush forests and grasslands.
MapMini_Des_1191: A forest on Route 2, between Evergreen and Deep Grey. A variety of trees densely formed a natural maze, many people have been lost in it, the leafy trees are difficult to penetrate the light, the whole forest appears a little dark inside. Because of this, the most common Pokemon in the forest are insects and flying attributes, and most of the trainers are insect-catching teenagers. So it's a good idea to prepare some antidotes and anesthetics before entering the forest.
MapMini_Des_1201: A wide road with flowers and plants on both sides is a good place for beginners to train Pokemon.
MapMini_Des_1202: A small road connecting Evergreen City and Deep Grey City, full of flowers and trees on both sides, the scenery is pleasant.
MapMini_Des_1203: A wide road, planted on both sides of many flowers and trees, is the only way for people to go to various cities.
MapMini_Des_1204: A wide road with high mountains on both sides, so you can often see some rocks and wild Pokemon.
MapMini_Des_1205: A wide river, banks on both sides of the green trees and rich grass, the water to the bottom.
MapMini_Des_1206: It is a rugged mountain road with steep cliffs and exotic stone buildings, and sometimes the sound of wild Pokemon can be heard echoing from the cliffs.
MapMini_Des_1207: A quiet path, on both sides of the road is green grass and winding river, there are some lovely animals playing in the river.
MapMini_Des_1208: It was a rough road surrounded by hills, with many piles of stones and sand, and needed to be careful.
MapMini_Des_1209: A road along the coast, where the waves were lapping against the shore, was lined with tall coconut trees and thick bushes.
MapMini_Des_1210: A path around the lake, which was clear to the bottom, and the shore was covered with thick grass and water plants.
MapMini_Des_1211: A road covered with large flowers, among which there were many Pokemons emitting strong electromagnetic waves.
MapMini_Des_1212: A road that runs along the foot of a mountain with small, clear streams and strange rocky terrain.
MapMini_Des_1213: A wide road flanked by lush forests and green meadows, the sky was blue and the sun was shining.
MapMini_Des_1214: A road round the mountain with high peaks and beautiful scenery, paved with flat flagstones.
MapMini_Des_1215: A road through the forest, with thick trees on both sides, and sunlight streaming through the leaves on the road.
MapMini_Des_1216: A mountain road, flanked by steep cliffs and thick trees, is rough and requires caution.
MapMini_Des_1217: An endless stretch of road with wide meadows and green woods on both sides, the scenery is pleasant.
MapMini_Des_1218: It is a busy road that connects many cities and small towns, and the scenery around it is also very different, with farmland, rivers, forests and hills.
MapMini_Des_1219: It is a major road that connects many cities and towns in a beautiful surroundings with natural attractions such as gardens, lakes and forests.
MapMini_Des_1220: It is a road along the coastline with spectacular sea views and stretches of beach, the air is fresh and pleasant, and it is a tourist destination.
MapMini_Des_1221: It is a waterway with the town of Zhenxin to the north and the town of Honglian to the south.
MapMini_Des_1222: It's a road that connects many mountain towns, and it's rugged, with beautiful peaks and running water along the way, making it a great place to hike.
MapMini_Des_1223: A more rugged mountain road with dense woods and waterfalls is often haunted by wild Pokemon.
MapMini_Des_1224: The road, which connects two small villages in the mountains, has wide fields and dense woodlands along the side, making it a good place for a leisurely stroll.
MapMini_Des_1225: A long stretch of road with wilderness and woods on both sides, with wild Pokemons hanging out by the roadside, many trainers look for challenges here.
MapMini_Des_1322: Tsukimi Mountain is difficult to climb, and the average traveler passes through the caves.
MapMini_Des_1318: Tsukimi Mountain is difficult to climb, and the average traveler passes through the caves.
MapMini_Des_1333: The Rock Hill Tunnel is a naturally formed underground tunnel on Route 10. Because the tunnel is very dark, in order to be smooth in it, the trainer should bring a Pokemon that can use the flash outside of the game.
MapMini_Des_1321: Gopher Burrows are long tunnels dug by gophers and tri-gophers that can be accessed at the opening of Road 11 and the opening of Road 2.
MapMini_Des_1299: The cave is the size of two islands and has five floors deep. In order to get through the cave, the rocks must be pushed by strange forces to slow down the flow of water.
MapMini_Des_1315: The road to the championship is divided into three layers, and the interior is like a maze. The trainer must use strange force to push the boulder to reach the exit.
MapMini_Des_1332: Here is a power plant on Road 10 in Kanto that has been abandoned for years, and some electromechanical facilities are still operating automatically. During the period of abandonment, it became the home of the electric Pokemon
MapMini_Des_1706: It is the hub of the map connecting Kanto and Chengdu
MapMini_Des_2101: A town where the winds of change are beginning to blow.
MapMini_Des_2102: The city with the fragrance of small flowers and the breeze.
MapMini_Des_2103: The ancient city is surrounded by a sea of trees and many kinds of scenery.
MapMini_Des_2104: A town where people and Pokemon coexist in simple peace.
MapMini_Des_2105: Highly developed cities, people and Pokemon can wander around at will.
MapMini_Des_2107: Listen to the melody of the wave of the city.
MapMini_Des_2108: A coastal city that benefits greatly from the sea.
MapMini_Des_2109: A town of fear and suspicion. A hideout for the ninjas.
MapMini_Des_2110: A mysterious mountain village cut into the rock face.
MapMini_Des_2111: It is a monument in the center of the city, southwest of the city of Platycodon, connected to Road 36 to the north and Road 32 to the east. Once the puzzle puzzle at the entrance is solved, the large underground room will be filled with unknown totems
MapMini_Des_2112: It's a park north of Mankin City, between Roads 35 and 36. This is where the bug hunt takes place. The Baoke all-around Competition Dome is right next to it
MapMini_Des_2113: It's a forest south of the city, next to the town of Sabipi. The forest is leafy, and even the day is as dark as the night, and there are huge numbers of insect-like Pokemon living in it.
MapMini_Des_2114: It is a huge mountain located in the eastern part of the city Capital area, west of the Champion Road and the Quartz Plateau, which can be reached from Kanto Road 28 after obtaining 16 badges.
MapMini_Des_2115: Lake of Wrath is mainly a large lake with a small number of inhabitants living nearby. It is said to be the largest lake in the metropolitan area. To the west of the lake was a huge maze of trees and a house deep in the maze.
MapMini_Des_2226: The road is steep and clearly divided into east and west. The road to the east leads up to the Quartz Plateau. Several steps on the west side make it a southbound trail that quickly returns to Route 27 on the southwest side.
MapMini_Des_2227: To the east it connects Route 26 and to the west it connects the town of Wakaba in the Metropolitan area.
MapMini_Des_2228: The road has trees and steps that make up the road, there are two pools in the east, and in the north there is a house where a girl who owns a big beak bird lives
MapMini_Des_2229: Much like Road 1 in Kanto District, the trainers start their new journey from Wakaba Town. There are large patches of grass where you can try to absorb the new Pokemon.
MapMini_Des_2230: It's the main character's second route. Grandpa Pokemon's house is here. When the protagonist first arrives here, he is asked to come here by Dr. Empty Wood.
MapMini_Des_2231: On the west side of the road is the gate leading to the city of Platycodon. The east side connects to an entrance to the Cave of Darkness, which leads to Route 45 after learning to break the rock. This road connects to Route 30 to the south.
MapMini_Des_2232: There are many patches of grass, many of which cannot be avoided. There is also a water road where there is no grass but some anglers are fishing.
MapMini_Des_2233: On the south side of the road there was a patch of grass, and on the southeast side there were fruit trees, ball trees, and that was about it, nothing special.
MapMini_Des_2234: The road has a yellow main road, which is flanked by thick grass and water flats. There are several trainers on the main road.
MapMini_Des_2235: It's not a long road and it's easy to avoid a lot of trainers. There's a ball tree on the other side of the surf over the pool.
MapMini_Des_2236: A short north-south road. It is the only road in the Pokemon world with five different exits.
MapMini_Des_2237: The road is short, but on the left there are two pairs of trainers, and on the right there is a trainer and three pom-trees, which produce three cones a day.
MapMini_Des_2238: There are two big bushes and two long steps. The way to get across Route 38 quickly is to go to the top road.
MapMini_Des_2239: There are many steps on this road, but no matter which direction you are going, you will not be restricted by the steps. There is a patch of grass at the corner of the road. The Moo pasture occupies a large part of the road.
MapMini_Des_2240: Above the road is a sandy beach, and in the middle and back is a waterway with a small land on the waterway.
MapMini_Des_2241: A very short waterway. There are whirlpool islands in this waterway
MapMini_Des_2242: There are four entrances and exits to the mountain, the uppermost cave being blocked by rocks near the exit. If you have not learned to surf, you can pass this road from Mount Lei Po.
MapMini_Des_2243: One section of the road has no grass, so you can avoid encountering wild Pokemon, but the other has a lot of grass.
MapMini_Des_2244: The road is divided into two parts, both of which are very easy to pass. The only patch of grass on the road lies between two lakes and can only be reached by surfing. However, there are many trainers on the road, and to pass quickly you must carefully avoid them.
MapMini_Des_2245: The road is mainly divided into two parts: the western section and the eastern section. The western section of the road has no branch, and the eastern section of the road has two small branches. There is a waterfall in the middle, but the protagonist cannot cross the road by water. There is an orange tree and a pond on the southeast side.
MapMini_Des_2246: A road to the east of this area. Although it is the last road with the metropolitan area number in the second generation game, it is connected to the first road number 29.
MapMini_Des_2247: Road 47 is very different from other roads in the metropolitan area, with high and low cliffs and shorelines, along the way there are two waterfalls, and the western side of the cliff leads to the city of Zhanlan.
MapMini_Des_2248: The road is short, with a large grass patch and two drawbridges. The northern entrance to the hunting grounds is totemic.
MapMini_Des_4001: Basking amid vibrant nature, this simple town is not shaded with any one hue.
MapMini_Des_4002: A town where the contrast between colorful flowers and deep, verdant forests is most beautiful.
MapMini_Des_4003: A whiff of salt is always in the air in this city, which is skirted by the ocean shore.
MapMini_Des_4004: This city is the main hub of industry in the Hoenn region, with the Devon Corporation as its beating heart.
MapMini_Des_4005: New trends are always the rage among the inhabitants of this small island town.
MapMini_Des_4006: People from many different regions gather and mingle in this bustling port city.
MapMini_Des_4007: This large city is located in the heart of the Hoenn region, at the crossroads of its nostalgic past and new technology.
MapMini_Des_4008: Thanks to the prevailing wind pattern, this town is always kept clear of falling volcanic ash.
MapMini_Des_4009: A town formed by scholars who gather to research meteorites.
MapMini_Des_4010: A popular spot in the Hoenn region, thanks to its hot springs, said to cure any ailment.
MapMini_Des_4011: The people and the Pokémon of this city follow nature's cues to rise each morning and end each day.
MapMini_Des_4012: This tourist destination is undergoing a revival, thanks to the popularity of its Pokémon Contest Spectaculars.
MapMini_Des_4013: Research is underway day and night in this city, all in the hope of understanding the distant reaches of space.
MapMini_Des_4014: This city, which rises from the crater of a great meteoroid crash, can only be reached through the sea or from the sky.
MapMini_Des_4015: This town first came into being as a floating storehouse used by people living on the ocean's surface.
MapMini_Des_4016: This city is blanketed in a profusion of colorful blooms. It plays host to the grand Pokémon League.
MapMini_Des_4101: This grassy path running between Littleroot Town and Oldale Town is perfect for doing fieldwork.
MapMini_Des_4102: Many Trainers gather on this route in the hope of encountering Pokémon in the wild.

PveTrialBase_Des_1:
1. Open the activity from 10:00 on Monday to 22:00 on Sunday. After the activity is opened, each player can only participate in the activity copy once a week. When the activity is opened, the bonus type of the copy attribute will be determined for this period. Not affected by Taiga, mega and other attributes)
2, you can consume gold to participate in the copy, after the selection of the copy lineup cannot be changed, all the spirit to carry items will not change, after successful participation, you can freely enter and exit the copy during the activity time
3, the copy will refresh a certain number of trainers, the higher the level of the player, the more difficult the challenge of the trainer. Defeating different trainer groups will refresh different God beasts, defeat God beasts as a copy of the challenge success
4, there are additional tasks in the copy to complete, players can find treatment npc treatment when their elves are dying or residual blood, after the treatment of spirit health status back to full, each copy can only be treated 5 times

Rule_Des_12:
1. All Pokémon can reset their training progress by consuming 100 Crystals
2. Resets are free and all items are 100% refunded during the first 3 days after server launch
3. After a Pokémon reset, the following attributes will be restored to their initial state, and all related training materials will be fully returned to your Bag:
(1) Level: Experience Candies and Gold Coins will be refunded
(2) Star Rank: Pokémon Shards and Gold Coins will be refunded
(3) Quality: Talismans, Gold Coins and Upgrade Stones will be refunded
(4) Awakening: Awakening Stones, Gold Coins and Pokémon will be refunded
4. The following Pokémon attributes will not be reset:
(1) Moves
(2) Abilities
(3) Nature
(4) Individual Values
(5) Effort Values
(6) Friendship Level
(7) Terastalization
(8) Star Crystalization
(9) Dynamax
(10) Pokémon Lord

Rule_Des_40:
[color=#CCFF33] Every month opens a season of Champion Stadium.Champion Stadium is divided into 6 stages: audition.promotion.points.elimination.resurrection.championship [/color]
[color=#CCFF33] Stage 1: Rules of the audition [/color]
a.after the audition is opened.players can choose to bring 20 elves to participate in this ring (you can choose again at the beginning of each audition)
b.The audition is a real-time matching mode.and each time you participate in the battle.you need to consume one audition ticket. Unlimited participation in
c during the opening time.8 people can open a ring.and cannot continue to match
d after the ring is opened. Each ring champion can get a ticket to participate in the promotion competition (the ticket is valid only for this season and automatically expires next season). Other bonuses can be rewarded to players who rank in each arena
[color=#CCFF33] Stage 2: Rules of promotion competition [/color]
a.after the promotion competition opens.players can choose to bring 20 elves to participate in this ring (each audition can be re-selected at the beginning)
b.the promotion competition is a real-time matching mode.each time to participate in the battle needs to consume a ticket for the promotion competition.matching 8 people to open a ring. After the ring is opened.it cannot continue to match
c.there is no limit to participate in the activity during the opening time (players who have won the promotion ring championship cannot participate again)
d.each ring champion can be eligible to participate in the points tournament.Other bonuses can be rewarded to players who rank in each arena
[color=#CCFF33] Stage 3: Points rules [/color]
a.qualified players will be randomly grouped after the opening of the activity.and each ring match will be re-grouped.each ring group is 8 people
b.after grouping.ring duel. The higher the ranking of the player can get more points
c.the accumulated points of each season reach a certain value can get the accumulated points reward.the top 64 players in the season can participate in the elimination tournament
[color=#CCFF33] Stage four: Elimination rules [/color]
a.grouping according to the points ranking.one is divided into 4 groups.each group of 16 players for the ring match
b.this ring match adopts BP mode for fighting.and finally the champion of each group can directly advance to the championship.and the runner-up of each group can participate in the resurrection match
c.after the end of the elimination game.The player corresponding to the ring ranking can receive the corresponding ranking reward.the reward is sent by email
[color=#CCFF33] Stage 5: Rules of the Resurrection game [/color]
a.all the features have been enabled players can participate in the resurrection game to vote.voting has a limit of times per day.can not vote for their own
b.participating players can every day like the world's players to launch a vote.canvassing has a limit of times per day.Additional items are required to collect votes
c.the top 2 players in the final vote can compete for the championship
[color=#CCFF33] Stage 6: Rules of the championship match [/color]
a.6 players in the championship match.the game adopts the roulette system.all players will directly play the game
b.the game adopts the BP mode.and it is two out of three games.the winning player can get 1 win.the player with the most cumulative wins wins the final champion (in the case of the same win.
c.Before the official start of the championship.the player can have a championship guess.choose a trainer you support.the successful player will get a guess reward at the end of the season
d.the championship will be rewarded according to the ranking of wins. The champion can also get exclusive fashion rewards [/color]
[color=#CCFF33] Ring battle rules [/color]
a.players participating in the ring must prepare within five minutes after the start of the match.If both players are not prepared.the system will judge whether one side wins or loses
c. Players who are prepared must be online.and offline players must be considered as giving up and losing.
d and BP modes.players must have more than or equal to 8 elves in their fairy ball and backpack before they can be prepared. Otherwise.the prize cannot be entered into the ring

MapMini_Des_5101: A town that can make you feel the scent of young leaves, and a kind of beginning. This is where you and your friends' homes are located.
MapMini_Des_5102: Located right next to the coast, it is a town of sand where you can smell the refreshing sea breeze. Professor Rowan's research institute, which is a diligent researcher of Pokémon, is a landmark of the town.
MapMini_Des_5103: The entire city was built on a dug hill by the inhabitants of the neighboring Oreburgh City. Jubilife City is the most technologically advanced place in the entire Sinnoh Region, and in the anime, it is also the largest city in the Sinnoh Region, with the city extending in all directions.
MapMini_Des_5104: Oreburgh City is a major coal industry town with abundant natural resources, and air vents protruding from the surface are located throughout the city to exchange the floating air underground and the fresh air above ground. The Oreburgh Mining Museum and the Oreburgh Mine are located here. Miners often take breaks in the gym between work. Roark, the owner of the gym, also welcomes citizens to train Pokémon in the charcoal pit.
MapMini_Des_5105: It is full of the fragrance of flowers, and it is a town for flower lovers. A large field of flowers extends beyond the flower path. In the middle of the town is a flower shop called Flower World.
MapMini_Des_5106: An ancient city that shows the ancient historical relics that are disappearing and forgotten.
MapMini_Des_5107: A place where hearts communicate with each other
MapMini_Des_5108: The climate of this town is mild, and both residents and Pokémon can live a laid-back life. There is a Pokémon Locker House and a Pokémon Center. Walk through the woods and you'll reach the entrance to the ruins.
MapMini_Des_5109: A city in the eastern part of Sinnoh. It is bordered by the sea to the north, Route 214 and Pastoria City to the south, and Route 215 to the west. The owner of Veilstone Gym, Maylene, lives here. In addition, the headquarters of the Galaxy is located here.
MapMini_Des_5110: At first, it was just a natural town to protect the vast wetlands in this area.
MapMini_Des_5111: A town that has passed on the life and history of the past to the present day. There is still an old ancestral hall in the middle of the town.
MapMini_Des_5112: An exotic port city bisected by canals. If you want to use your brain, head to the library. If you want to move your muscles, head to the gym. There are always large ships docked at the pier.
MapMini_Des_5113: The trees and buildings were covered with a thick layer of snow, and the city was transformed into a silvery-white world. The Gym is located in the very center of the city, and the Temple of Snow Peak sits in its depths.
MapMini_Des_5114: A port city built on the intricate topography of the cape. Elevated sidewalks are its biggest feature. There is a dojo on the high platform. There is also a lively market on the beach. The bright light of the navigation lighthouse shines on the Sinnoh area.
MapMini_Des_5115: Clear the Road of Champions to reach the Pokémon League, or you can enter Road 224.
MapMini_Des_5116: The Pokémon League is an island located in the sea with a huge castle-like structure that is the location for challenging the Four Heavenly Kings and the Champion.
MapMini_Des_5201: A forest path covered with green leaves and the fragrance of trees.
MapMini_Des_5202: Young trainers often compete with each other in the winding grass.
MapMini_Des_5203: A path close to the town but with a touch of nature.
MapMini_Des_5204: Ponds and trees are dotted on both sides, and the paths are full of natural charm. Passing through the barren paths paved by the excavation of the high platform, Floaroma Town is in sight.
MapMini_Des_5205: A wide bridge spans the wide pool, and anglers are leisurely casting their lines on the bridge. The gentle flow of the river and the undulating terrain make this road full of adventure. Next to the entrance to Eterna Forest, there is a cottage for passers-by to relieve their fatigue.
MapMini_Des_5206: The asphalt-paved bike path is a paradise for cyclists. The entrance to the psychedelic cave can be seen underneath the bike path.
MapMini_Des_5207: Located at the foot of Mount Coronet, the road is made up of uneven rock faces.
MapMini_Des_5208: Located on Mount Coronet, the cliffs and thriving grassy paths flank the sides with contrasting views. Grandpa Tree, who loves nature, Pokémon and tree fruits, lives here.
MapMini_Des_5209: The stream that winds through the woods and grass gives a feeling of relaxation. The Lost Tower is the resting place for the soul of a Pokémon after it reaches the end of its life.
MapMini_Des_5210: A natural valley created by nature in the mountains, where a thick fog is always filled. Wilma's home is nestled in a valley far from the crowds. Dense and towering weeds are everywhere, making passers-by itch their noses. A mountain hut café built in the middle of the woods, most famous for its freshly squeezed milk.
MapMini_Des_5211: The trail runs from both sides through Mount Coronet, arguably the steepest in the Sinnoh Region.
MapMini_Des_5212: A high wall encloses a large area of land and occupies almost half of the road. On the other side of the fence is a mansion called the Pokémon House. The backyard there seems to be the pride of the owner of the mansion. Heavy rains here are perennial, and the roads are full of water. Trainers are also often drenched in soup.
MapMini_Des_5213: The rocks near the sea act as breakwaters to maintain the tranquility of the shore. There is a resort hotel built on the high platform. In a small house by the sea, there lived a man who was commonly known as Dr. Footstep。
MapMini_Des_5214: The path that connects Veilstone City to the lake is at best untouched and at worst overgrown wilderness.
MapMini_Des_5215: Heavy rains are continuous all year round. Only a few reckless trainers who are not afraid of the rain gather here.
MapMini_Des_5216: Mount Coronet stretches down the mountain road, and the thick snow that has accumulated all year round slows down the pace of passers-by.
MapMini_Des_5217: The snow falling from Mount Coronet formed a blizzard that blew in. Please be aware before stepping here.
MapMini_Des_5218: It's a small trail, but it's a hidden gem among anglers.
MapMini_Des_5219: Just a 5-second walk from Sandgem Town, the white sand beach is a soothing breeze blowing in your face.
MapMini_Des_5220: With a light breeze and flowing tides, this is the perfect place to enjoy sea bathing. If you are tired of swimming, you can also take a break on the sandbank.
MapMini_Des_5221: A path full of greenery through the sparse trees.
MapMini_Des_5222: On the beach that stretches along the roadside, people are bustling here to challenge and enjoy the fun of fishing. There's an uncle who likes to fish around, and there's a room where people compare the size of the Pokémon they've caught.
MapMini_Des_5223: Reefs and shoals jutting out of the sea block the sea route for passers-by.
MapMini_Des_5224: Grass and rocky mountains, sea and shallows. It's like a microcosm of the Sinnoh Region.
