NpcTalk_Des_408971: Hello, I'm a reporter for Jubilife TV, but my home is in Canalave City.
NpcTalk_Des_408972: By the way, I heard that you are a very enthusiastic trainer, can you help me catch a Tentacool?
NpcTalk_Des_408981: Tentacool, thank you so much, now I would like to add a photo of it to my report.
NpcTalk_Des_408982: This, please help me send it to the TV station, it's very close, it's next door.
NpcTalk_Des_408991: Oh, Miss Hughes's manuscript? Thank you for sending it.
NpcTalk_Des_409011: Remember Riley from Iron Island, there are some island supplies that need to be brought to him, can I trouble you?
NpcTalk_Des_409021: Oh oh oh, thank you for sending this, they haven't been on the island in a long time.
NpcTalk_Des_409022: By the way, remember the previous Team Galactic, there seems to be a fish that slipped through the net in the lower layer of Iron Island, but he doesn't seem to have done any damage.
NpcTalk_Des_409032: Boss, they don't know where they're going, and the cadres can't be contacted, can't I cultivate here as a trainer?
NpcTalk_Des_409041: Oh oh oh, it's okay, I heard that he really didn't do anything about Pokémon, but thank you for helping me check the situation.
NpcTalk_Des_409051: How good are your rock climbing, I found Nugget around Mount Coronet on Route 211 earlier, the location tells you, can you go and pick it up for me?
NpcTalk_Des_409082: Thank you so much, it's all back.
NpcTalk_Des_409091: Trainer, I haven't seen you for a long time, and there is a situation where I have to trouble you to run errands again, and I have worked hard for you. Veilstone City and Canalave City are required.
NpcTalk_Des_409101: Okay, here you go, be careful on the road.
NpcTalk_Des_409111: It is the material of the Wind and Snow Villa, and it is the road.
NpcTalk_Des_409122: Thank you so much, thank you for your help.
NpcTalk_Des_409131: Oh yes, you challenged Maylene from Veilstone Gym, right?
NpcTalk_Des_409132: Can you please help me send this to her, I won't be in touch with her.
NpcTalk_Des_409141: Candice? Thank you for sending it. I also have a letter I want to send to her, so please pass it on to me if you go back.
NpcTalk_Des_409152: Thank you for your help, great work.
NpcTalk_Des_409171: Will you be able to go to Lake Acuity? I've lost something there, but it's too cold, I....
NpcTalk_Des_409202: Thank you so much, that's it, thank you for helping me get it back.
NpcTalk_Des_409211: By the way, in addition to Snowpoint Gym, there are also a lot of trainers in Snowpoint City, because the environment is terrible, everyone's level is quite high, do you want to try it?
NpcTalk_Des_409221: Ha, yes, I like to learn.
NpcTalk_Des_409222: I can't tell you that you should be a lot better than Candice.
NpcTalk_Des_409232: It's not an opponent, thank you for your guidance.
NpcTalk_Des_409241: I've just seen it all, it's my turn!
NpcTalk_Des_409251: Do you remember that I told you before that my unobtrusive husband, can you go and help me find him, I heard that it is on 224 Road.
NpcTalk_Des_409261: Hehe, my favorite thing is to travel and adventure, are you a trainer?
NpcTalk_Des_409271: Then come with me for a fight!
NpcTalk_Des_409272: It's amazing, so if only I could give it to her when I pass by Sunyshore City, I don't like to stay at home.
NpcTalk_Des_409281: Uh, okay, it's better to have news than no news, thank you for your help.
NpcTalk_Des_409291: My favorite thing to do is look through a telescope from the lighthouse.
NpcTalk_Des_409292: By the way, I found a few Nuggets on Route 223, can you go and pick them up for me?
NpcTalk_Des_409322: That's it, thank you, I'm going to keep looking at the scenery.
NpcTalk_Des_409331: The house was burglarized, and I heard you would help, right?
NpcTalk_Des_409362: Thank you for your help, if only our Volkner owner were half as enthusiastic as you.
NpcTalk_Des_409371: I've been told that some guys calling themselves Team Galactic are messing around in Victory Road, can you please go and get rid of them?
NpcTalk_Des_409382: Do you know how to get to the flower field, which is the legendary Road 224 or something.
NpcTalk_Des_409391: Uh, let's get into a fight first.
NpcTalk_Des_409392: Have you ever heard of a Pokémon called Shaymin? I'm lost.
NpcTalk_Des_409401: Oh oh oh, you said they were just getting lost and scurrying around, that's fine, but just get rid of it, thank you for your help.
NpcTalk_Des_409411: Can the trainer bother you with a favor, the Berry I planted before on Route 224 should be ripe.
NpcTalk_Des_409412: Can you please help me pick it back, if there is still fruit in the future, it will belong to you, you can pick it, please.
NpcTalk_Des_409432: By the way, thank you, by the way, I want to invite my sister to come, but she seems to be a big celebrity and it is difficult to make an appointment, so you can help me send her a letter.
NpcTalk_Des_409441: Oh oh oh, sister's letter, thank you for sending it.
NpcTalk_Des_409451: I have two disciples who practice on Victory Road, can you please help me find it?
NpcTalk_Des_409461: Oh oh oh, thank you for sending the letter.
NpcTalk_Des_409471: Great work, thank you for sending this.
NpcTalk_Des_409491: Remember those Team Galactics? I had seen their cadres dangling around the send-off road.
NpcTalk_Des_409492: I don't know what they're trying to do, but I'd like to see what they want to do.
NpcTalk_Des_409521: Is that so, but there are some very sacred places where you should not let these people with impure purposes go in and out, I'm sorry for you this time.
NpcTalk_Des_409531: I'm so angry, I just went out to travel, but things were stolen, and I can't beat them.
NpcTalk_Des_409561: What, did you help get it back?
NpcTalk_Des_409562: Thank you so much, nothing less, thank you for your help, the mood is beautiful again.
NpcTalk_Des_409571: Lucas said that he had found out that Giratina had reappeared, and that you should go and help him, his strength should not be able to handle it.
NpcTalk_Des_409581: Here it is, look, the legendary Giratina, do you beat it? I just failed.
NpcTalk_Des_409601: I don't know when it appears, but if it does, I still have to deal with it, thank you, thank you for coming over and helping.
NpcTalk_Des_409602: Everything about Mount Coronet belongs to Team Galactic!
NpcTalk_Des_409603: Oh, you can't be complacent for too long.
NpcTalk_Des_409605: Not sure what that Spear Pillar is.
NpcTalk_Des_409606: Ah, I heard you rescued those three Pokémon of the Lake?
NpcTalk_Des_409607: I do what I'm told, but there are times when I don't mean it.
NpcTalk_Des_409609: Anyway, I tried my best, I can do whatever you want, and I don't know what's right or wrong.
NpcTalk_Des_409610: I don't want to stop you, but let's fight.
NpcTalk_Des_409611: Go ahead, deep down I told me that it was you who should be supported.
NpcTalk_Des_409613: There are some other cadres in there, you have to be careful.

Rule_Des_54:
1. The team battle BOSS opens twice a week, with the following schedule: Monday 10 AM - Wednesday 11 PM, Thursday 10 AM - Sunday 11 PM.
2. After each team battle opens, players can choose to participate in other players' BOSS battles or invite friends to join their own BOSS battles.
3. Each time, five BOSS will refresh. Only after defeating the previous BOSS can players see the next ones, and the difficulty of the BOSS increases the further you go.
4. Players will start challenging from level 1 after forming a team. Once they win at level 1, they cannot change their team and must continue challenging until they clear all levels or fail a level.
5. Players can only receive rewards for clearing the first team challenge; there will be no rewards for clearing subsequent challenges.
6. In each event, if players clear all levels for the first time or fail after challenging more than one level, they can choose to capture sprites in the cleared dungeons, where they may encounter shiny sprites.
7. In this dungeon capture, players cannot engage in battle and can only use Poké Balls to capture sprites. Each round, the monsters have a very low chance of triggering an escape. Rule_Des_55:
1. The Sky Arena opens one season per week on Saturdays and Sundays.
2. Teams can be formed at the start of the season, and players can participate in matching battles initiated by the team captain from 19:00 to 23:00 every day to advance to higher ranks.
3. On the last day of the season, which is 23:00 on Sundays, team rewards will be settled based on the team's points. At the same time, the guild ranking reward will be settled based on the sum of the points of all teams in the guild.
4. Gameplay rules:
a. Before initiating a match, the team leader needs to create a team, and two team members need to join the team room and set it to a ready state.
b. For the first match of each season, the team captain will be consulted whether to bind the team. After binding, the team cannot be changed this season.
c. After successfully matching with the opponent, the team will enter the venue selection: one team will randomly dispatch members to venue A, and the other team will dispatch members to venues A and B, and so on until all three venues dispatch members for a one-on-one battle.
d. Three games, two wins: Three independent matches on each field, and the team that wins two games wins.
5. Other rules:
a. After binding a team, it is not possible to withdraw from the guild before the end of the season.
b. Only the team leader can initiate a match, and the team leader can voluntarily surrender to other members.
c. Will not match with teams from the same guild.

Eudemon_Des_11697: The wings of this creature resemble the wide sleeves of an elaborate costume, much like those worn by dramatic dancers. With a powerful, fiery wind, it can fly faster, and the red feathers atop its head can release flames. When flying at night, it resembles a sky full of twinkling stars. The feathers on its lower body spread out like the flowing hem of a skirt. Every movement it makes is as graceful as a dancer's, which is why it is highly popular in the Eastern Huang region. It loves to show off its most beautiful feathers to its trainer and, when happy, will dance, lifting the spirits of those who watch.
Eudemon_Des_11698: This creature has a vicious personality and is extremely ferocious. Its large mouth on its chest can consume food up to twice its body size. With an enormous appetite, it is often in a state of hunger and finds it hard to maintain rationality. It has nearly driven some species to extinction due to its insatiable hunger. As a result, people use its three major weaknesses—fire, the color red, and loud noises—to drive it away. When in a state of rage, the bone spurs on its body become even longer and more pronounced. It is incredibly fast, able to use its tail to instantly pierce prey while sprinting. To keep it under control, it requires a constant supply of food; otherwise, it becomes nearly impossible to capture. If it is frequently left hungry, it will actively destroy its Poké Ball and sever the bond with its trainer.
Eudemon_Des_11699: In this state, its personality becomes calm and stable. Its strength decreases due to the seal, but its defense significantly increases. It no longer fears the three weaknesses of its evil form. Although its large size may make it seem unapproachable, it possesses a compassionate heart. To prevent its evil counterpart from escaping and harming others, it typically stays in remote mountains. If one day you happen to spot Nian outside the mountains, it may signal that something significant is about to happen in the nearby area.

Rule_Des_56:
1. Event Activation and Participation Rules:
○ The event will activate at a specific time, with the duration of each activation varying. The end time of the event is based on the countdown timer at the event entrance.
○ This event shares progress across the entire server!
○ Players who reach level 30 can participate in the event. Initially, they receive a certain number of tickets (Trace Entry Tickets), and when the number of tickets owned has not reached the limit (240), one ticket is automatically restored every 12 minutes.
2. Gameplay Rules:
○ Initially activate a grid in the first layer of the gym; vertices adjacent to the activated grid within the step range (initially 1) are in an activatable state.
■ When all four nodes of the grid are activated, the grid can be activated!
○ There will be a special grid at the entrance of each layer of the gym; after activating it, you can enter the next layer (the initial grid of the next layer is automatically activated!).
○ Grid Types:
■ Direct Activation Grid: After the four nodes are activated, the grid is directly activated.
● Depending on reward configurations, these are divided into normal grids, normal treasure chest grids, intermediate treasure chest grids, advanced treasure chest grids, skill/blessing grids!
■ Defeat Boss Activation Grid: Defeat the Boss on the grid to activate it.
PS: Legendary Pokémon are protected by the gym, with a maximum damage cap of 100,000 per turn.
○ Node Types:
■ Combat Event: Defeat all Pokémon within the node to activate the node.
■ Delegation Event: Accept and deliver delegated tasks. Upon meeting the required completion times for the event, the node is activated.
■ Dispatch Event: Dispatch Pokémon. Upon reaching the required dispatch quantity, the node is activated.
■ Boss Event: Defeat the Boss on the node to activate it.
3. Skill Rules:
○ Red, yellow, and blue skills can be obtained from skill/blessing grids.
○ Players can choose any 2 of the already activated skills, and automatically obtain a third green skill based on their selection.
ps: The above three skills only take effect for all battling Pokémon during dungeon exploration battles.
4. Blessing Rules:
○ Step Length: Initially, the step length range is 1, more steps can be obtained from skill/blessing grids.
ps: Nodes adjacent within the step length range of activated nodes are also activatable nodes!
○ Synergy: Can be obtained from skill/blessing grids. When an unactivated node is surrounded by activated nodes, it triggers a synergy effect, directly activating that node.
○ Attribute Blessings: Can be obtained from skill/blessing grids. Six types of attribute bonuses only take effect for all battling Pokémon during dungeon exploration battles.
5. Grid Reward Rules:
○ Direct Activation Grid: Directly receive rewards from the grid.
■ Normal Grid: Small server-wide loot rewards.
■ Normal Treasure Chest Grid: Small amount of server-wide loot rewards.
■ Intermediate Treasure Chest Grid: Large amount of server-wide loot rewards.
■ Advanced Treasure Chest Grid: Huge amount of server-wide loot rewards.
■ Skill/Blessing Grid: Receive server-wide loot rewards while also obtaining skills or blessings.
○ Defeat Boss Activation Grid: Receive participation rewards each time you participate. Split other rewards based on damage dealt. Upon grid activation, receive server-wide loot rewards!
ps: Consuming 500 Trace Entry Tickets allows continuous receipt of server-wide loot.
6. Node Reward Rules:
○ Node Combat Event: The player who defeats all Pokémon first receives individual rewards.
○ Node Delegation Event: Individual rewards are received each time a delegation task is completed.
■ Each player can only complete one task per node per day!
○ Node Dispatch Event: Receive individual rewards based on the number of dispatched Pokémon.
■ Each player can only dispatch one Pokémon per node per day!
○ Node Boss Event: Receive participation rewards each time you participate. Split personal rewards based on damage dealt.

Rule_Des_57:
1. Basic rules of fair competition:
a)、 Fair competition is a cross server gameplay
b) After the start of the new season, there will be a ranking competition or a ranking competition+elimination competition system

2. Basic rules for ranking competitions:
a)、 The rank competition is 1V1 real-time matching
b), and players who participate in the gameplay a certain number of times can receive rewards
c). After the rank competition ends, the rank rewards and ranking rewards will be settled, and the rewards will be distributed via email

3. Basic rules for elimination matches:
a)、 When the elimination round starts, the top 32 players in the rank round will be invited to participate. The elimination round will divide the 32 players into 4 groups, and the round of 16 and 8 will be determined by 1v1 each other. After that, they will enter the championship round, where the round of 4, round of 2, and the final champion will be determined. At the beginning of the elimination round, a notification will be sent to the participating players, and they need to arrange their lineup and prepare within the entry time. Players who are not ready by the end of the entry time will be directly judged as losing. The elimination round is a two win three game system, and players who end the battle will receive ranking rewards directly from their current ranking. The earlier they fail, the lower their ranking will be. Offline players' rewards are distributed via email.

Rule_Des_48:
1.Battle Types
a) Mega Battle: Pokémon with Mega Evolution can freely set their Mega forms.
b) Tera Battle: All Pokémon can freely choose their Tera Type.
c) Dynamax Battle: All Pokémon automatically enter battle in Dynamax form.
2.Event Schedule
Matches are available every Monday to Friday from 20:00 to 22:00 (UTC+8).
Players can freely choose one battle type per match.
3.Team Selection & Fair Play
Upon entering, players select a limited number of Pokémon and held items from a system-provided pool (player progression does not affect availability).
Teams can be manually arranged during the event period.
4.Match Rules & Progression
Wins accumulate toward rewards; losses do not deduct points.
Unlimited matchmaking during event hours.
After 5 losses, players must re-select Pokémon/items (manual or auto-pick allowed).
5.Ranking & Rewards
Weekly rankings prioritize highest win count (earliest achiever ranks first if tied).
Rewards are distributed via in-game mail 1 hour after the final day’s event ends.
6.Data Reset
All progress is reset when the next event begins.

Rule_Des_36:
[color=#CCFF33]Each season lasts for one week, and the Tianwang Tournament is divided into two stages: the Points Competition and the Tianwang PK Competition[/color]
[color=#CCFF33]Stage 1: Rules of the Points Competition[/color]
a. After it is opened, you can choose one type of spirit attribute to participate. Once selected, this attribute cannot be changed during this season. You can only send out spirits with this attribute to fight, and the same spirit cannot be sent out.
b. The competition is opened from 20:00 to 22:00 every Monday to Friday. Players who win the competition can get points (the stronger the attribute restraint relationship of the defeated opponent, the higher the multiple of points that can be obtained).
c. When the points obtained in each season reach a certain number, you can receive points rewards.
d. Players who rank among the top 100 for each attribute can receive ranking rewards, which will be sent via email at the end of the season.
[color=#CCFF33]Stage 2: Rules of the Tianwang PK Competition[/color]
a. The top 32 players in the total ranking of the Points Competition are selected to participate. The competition is opened at 15:00 every Saturday and Sunday.
b. They are divided into 4 groups according to certain rules for the PK competition. The PK competition adopts a best-of-three system. The winning players can enter the next round of the competition until the final four Tianwang titles are determined.
c. Players who participate in the Tianwang Tournament will receive corresponding ranking rewards, which will be sent via email after the season ends.
[color=#CCFF33]Battle Rules of the Tianwang PK Competition[/color]
a. Participating players must prepare within five minutes after the start of the competition. Players who do not prepare will be regarded as giving up the competition and will be judged as losers.
b. If neither of the two players prepares, the system will determine the winner or loser of one of them.
c. Prepared players must be online. Being offline will also be regarded as giving up the competition and will be judged as losers.
[color=#CCFF33]Rules for Liking[/color]
a. You can like the top 3 players on all leaderboards every day, and you can like 5 times a day.
b. By clicking, you can randomly obtain a large number of attribute slate fragments.

Rule_Des_53:
1. Guild bosses are common bosses in the entire guild, and all guild players can participate in challenges.
2. Damage settlement is based on the current damage caused during each challenge. If the boss is killed during the battle, other players participating in the challenge will be forced to settle the battle.
3. Challenge bosses to deal damage every day and receive challenge rewards, limited to 3 times a day.
4. Finally, when the boss is killed, all guild players will receive boss kill rewards. Each boss reward can only be obtained once per season, and changing the guild will not reset it.

Rule_Des_581:
1. World Championship Season Basic Rules:
a) The World Championship is a cross channel gameplay, with one season per week
b) Each season settlement will be based on the ranking of the player's rank, and promotion, relegation, or relegation processing will be carried out
c) The ranking reward will be settled once a week at 23:00, and the reward will be sent via email
d)In each battle of the World Championships, players are only allowed to share Mega and Mega 3 times, and Taijing 3 times

2) Gameplay Rules
a) When the function is unlocked, the rank will be graded based on the player's strength and the number of days they have created characters
b) During the season, players can perform real-time matching
Battle, when the player reaches the Diamond rank, the BP game mode will be activated. Victory or failure in the battle will result in different points depending on the strength difference between the two sides. The first victory in the battle every day will earn a daily first win reward< br>e)、 After the end of each day's schedule, players will receive rank rewards based on their daily rank (rewards will be sent via email). Players who win a certain number of matches each season will receive additional cumulative win rewards, which can only be received once per season

a) Snake grouping: Qualifiers divided into 4 groups

e) Must stay online after readying or forfeit
f) Attribute champions crowned Gym Leaders

Rule_Des_60:
1. Only the Shiny and non-Shiny forms of the same Pokémon can swap their training progress
2. The swap of Pokémon training progress cannot be revoked; if you wish to revert it, you can only perform the swap again
3. The swap of Pokémon training progress includes the following Pokémon attributes:
(1) Level and level experience points
(2) Star rank and progress
(3) Activated Abilities and the unlock success rate of unactivated Abilities
(4) Nature and the cost of Nature Reset
(5) Equipped Moves and TM activation status
(6) Quality grade
(7) Individual Values (including the activation status of Crowns)
(8) Effort Values
(9) Friendship level
(10) Activated Terastal Type
(11) Star Crystalization level and Blessing Value
(12) Dynamax level and Success Value
(13) Boss rank and Success Rate
(14) Equipped Mega Stones
(15) Equipped Held Items
(16) Equipped Costumes
4. After the training progress swap, the Awakening level will be reset, and the relevant Awakening materials will be returned to your Bag

SeasonChannelBase_RuleDes_1:
I. Gameplay Instructions
(1) Season Duration: 2025.12.01--2025.12.28
(2) Matching Time:
· 08:00 on the same day ~ 02:00 the next day
(3) Matching Rules:
· Cross-server matching; players with the same IP will not meet
· Match opponents based on points and winning/losing streaks
II. Ranks & Leaderboard
(1) Rank Promotion: Promote to the next rank when points meet requirements
· Order Silver: 0~100 Points
· Glory Gold: 100~300 Points
· Noble Platinum: 300~600 Points
· Eternal Diamond: 600~900 Points
· Supreme Starshine: 900~1200 Points
· Supreme King: 1200 Points and above
(2) Leaderboard: Players who reach the Supreme King rank will be ranked by points
· For tied points, sorted by promotion time (earlier promotion ranks higher)
III. Battle System
(1) Season Type: Mega Season
(2) Battle Modes:
· Regular Battle: For ranks below Diamond, matching leads directly to battle.
· BP Battle: Diamond and above ranks adopt BP process, including Pokémon deployment and ban phases
(3) Victory/Defeat Judgment: Win when the number of opponent's exhausted Pokémon reaches the specified value
IV. Reputation System
(1) Initial Score: 100 Points
· Reputation score resets every season
(2) Point Deduction Behaviors:
· Maliciously stalling turn time: 1 point deducted per turn if still stalling after warning (max 10 points per battle)!
· BP Escape: 10 points deducted per escape starting from the second violation!
(3) Point Addition Behaviors:
· 1 point added to reputation score after battle if no violations occur during the match
(4) Impacts of Reputation Score:
· Turn action time shortened to 27/26/25/24 seconds!
· Reduced Rewards: Lower reputation score leads to more reward deductions (10%/20%/30%/40% deduction based on score)!
· Permanent match ban for the current season if reputation score is below 50 points!!!
V. Reward System
(1) Battle Rewards: Gold Coins and Jade Shard Coins are available for each battle
· Higher ranks yield more rewards; Supreme King rank can even get rare Crystal Coins!
· Weekly upper limit for reward acquisition
(2) Rank Achievement Rewards: Claim corresponding rank achievement rewards when reaching a new rank each season
(3) Rank Settlement Rewards: Corresponding rewards issued based on the final rank at the end of the season
· Accumulate 50/100 battles on Champion Road to increase settlement rewards by 5%/10%
(4) Ranking Rewards: Top 300 players on the leaderboard will receive additional rewards after the season ends; higher ranking means richer rewards
(5) Mission Rewards: Earn rewards by completing daily/weekly missions
(6) Season Shop: Exchange precious season-limited items with season tokens
VI. Season Pass
(1) Level Up: Gain experience to level up by completing missions
(2) Reward Types:
· Free Rewards: Available to all players
· Premium Rewards: Unlocked after purchasing the pass

SeasonChannelBase_RuleDes_2:
I. Gameplay Instructions
(1) Season Duration: 2025.12.31--2026.01.27
(2) Matching Time:
· 08:00 on the same day ~ 02:00 the next day
(3) Matching Rules:
· Cross-server matching; players with the same IP will not meet
· Match opponents based on points and winning/losing streaks
II. Ranks & Leaderboard
(1) Rank Promotion: Promote to the next rank when points meet requirements
· Order Silver: 0~100 Points
· Glory Gold: 100~300 Points
· Noble Platinum: 300~600 Points
· Eternal Diamond: 600~900 Points
· Supreme Starshine: 900~1200 Points
· Supreme King: 1200 Points and above
(2) Leaderboard: Players who reach the Supreme King rank will be ranked by points
· For tied points, sorted by promotion time (earlier promotion ranks higher)
III. Battle System
(1) Season Type: Terastal Doubles Season
(2) Battle Gameplay:
· Infinite Terastal: All Pokémon will have the ability to Terastallize! Seize 6 Terastallization opportunities and freely choose the desired Terastal Type to defeat the opponent!
· Doubles Battle: Players will deploy two teams simultaneously, with 3 Pokémon per team. Control both Pokémon at the same time in battle to win!
(3) Victory/Defeat Judgment: Win when the number of opponent's exhausted Pokémon reaches the specified value
IV. Reputation System
(1) Initial Score: 100 Points
· Reputation score resets every season
(2) Point Deduction Behaviors:
· Maliciously stalling turn time: 1 point deducted per turn if still stalling after warning (max 10 points per battle)!
· BP Escape: 10 points deducted per escape starting from the second violation!
(3) Point Addition Behaviors:
· 1 point added to reputation score after battle if no violations occur during the match
(4) Impacts of Reputation Score:
· Turn action time shortened to 27/26/25/24 seconds!
· Reduced Rewards: Lower reputation score leads to more reward deductions (10%/20%/30%/40% deduction based on score)!
· Permanent match ban for the current season if reputation score is below 50 points!!!
V. Reward System
(1) Battle Rewards: Gold Coins and Jade Shard Coins are available for each battle
· Higher ranks yield more rewards; Supreme King rank can even get rare Crystal Coins!
· Weekly upper limit for reward acquisition
(2) Rank Achievement Rewards: Claim corresponding rank achievement rewards when reaching a new rank each season
(3) Rank Settlement Rewards: Corresponding rewards issued based on the final rank at the end of the season
· Accumulate 50/100 battles on Champion Road to increase settlement rewards by 5%/10%
(4) Ranking Rewards: Top 300 players on the leaderboard will receive additional rewards after the season ends; higher ranking means richer rewards
(5) Mission Rewards: Earn rewards by completing daily/weekly missions
(6) Season Shop: Exchange precious season-limited items with season tokens
VI. Season Pass
(1) Level Up: Gain experience to level up by completing missions
(2) Reward Types:
· Free Rewards: Available to all players
· Premium Rewards: Unlocked after purchasing the pass

PreviewText411: The Cake Party is finally here! Come on, let's challenge the Gym Leader together!
PreviewText412: Go for it! Beat the Gym Leader to get tickets, which you can use to challenge the Boss!

PreviewText422: That exciting? Then we have to go for it!
PreviewText431: Oh right, the items you get from defeating the Boss can be used to draw prizes in the lottery pool!
PreviewText432: What's more, the prize pool updates round by round—the later the rounds, the better the rewards!

PreviewText442: Wow, this is such a great deal! I'm already looking forward to it!

PreviewText512: Wow, but the cake still seems to be in the making—why don't we go help together?

PreviewText531: Come on, let's submit all the ingredients we've collected!
PreviewText532: I heard submitting ingredients can get you tons of rewards—it's totally worth it!
PreviewText541: Look look, the cake is almost finished!
PreviewText542: Once the cake is ready, the lively cake party can officially start!
PreviewText611: What benefits are there when the cake party starts?
PreviewText612: I heard you can get rewards just by staying in the Battle Center—effortlessly!
PreviewText621: Is that all? It feels just so-so!
PreviewText622: Not at all! Cake blind boxes will randomly spawn in the Battle Center—pick them up for random rewards!
PreviewText631: There are even lottery tickets in the cake blind boxes—they say you automatically get lottery entry!
PreviewText632: Then I'm going to check the entire Battle Center and collect all the cake blind boxes!
PreviewText641: The grand prize will definitely be mine!

SeasonChannelBase_RuleDes_3:
1. Gameplay Overview
a) Season Duration: 2026.01.31--2026.02.27
b) Matchmaking Hours: 0:00 – 2:00; 8:00 – 24:00
c) Matchmaking Rules: · Cross-server matching, players with the same IP will not meet · Opponents are matched based on points, win/loss streaks.

2. Tiers & Ranking
a) Tier Promotion: Reach the required points to advance.
· Order Silver: 0~100 pts
· Glory Gold: 100~300 pts
· Noble Platinum: 300~600 pts
· Eternal Diamond: 600~900 pts
· Supreme Star: 900~1200 pts
· Ultimate King: 1200 pts & above
b) Leaderboard: Players who reach the Ultimate King tier will be ranked based on points.
· If points are tied, ranking is determined by who reached the tier first.

3. Battle System
a) Season Type: Ultimate Talent Season
b) Battle Features:
· Talent Boost: Earn Talent Points through battles, upgrade your Talent Tree for stronger stat bonuses!
· Random Scenes: Different scenes activate different statuses, terrains, and weather!
Water Terrain: At the end of the 3rd turn, confuses all non-Water-type Buddies on the field.
Grass Terrain: At the end of the 3rd turn, inflicts a 3-turn Bind on all non-Grass-type Buddies on the field. This Bind deals no damage and cannot be overridden.
Rock Terrain: Inflicts the Smack Down effect on all Buddies on the field.
Snow Terrain: After a Buddy remains on the field for 3 consecutive turns, at the end of each subsequent turn, that Buddy has a 30% chance to be Frozen.
c) Victory Condition: Win by making a specified number of opponent's Buddies faint.
d) Battle Modes:
· Below King Tier: Standard Battle. Start fighting directly.
· King Tier: BP (Ban/Pick) Battle. After selecting three Buddies from your lineup, the battle begins.

4. Reputation System
a) Starting Score: 100 pts
· Reputation score resets each season.
b) Score Deductions:
· Maliciously stalling turn time: After a warning, 1 point deducted per turn, max 10 points per match!
· BP Escape: From the second offense onward, 10 points deducted per escape!
c) Score Additions:
· No rule violations during the match: +1 Reputation point after the match ends.
d) Reputation Effects:
· Turn action time will be greatly reduced!
· Reduced Rewards: Lower reputation leads to more rewards deducted, up to 40%!
· If reputation falls below 50 points, you will be permanently banned for the remainder of the season!!!

5. Reward System
a) Battle Rewards: Earn Gold and Shard Coins after each match.
· Higher tiers grant more rewards. King Tier also grants rare Crystal Coins!
· Starting from the season launch, higher reward caps unlock every 7 days!
b) Tier Achievement Rewards: Reach a new tier each season to claim corresponding rewards.
c) Tier Season-End Rewards: Rewards issued based on your final tier at season end.
· Complete 50/100 cumulative matches in Victory Road to boost season-end rewards by 5%/10%.
d) Ranking Rewards: Top 300 players on the leaderboard receive extra rewards after the season ends. Higher rank = better rewards.
e) Mission Rewards: Complete Daily/Weekly Missions for rewards.
f) Season Shop: Use Season Tokens to exchange for precious season-limited items.


6. Season Pass
a) Level Up: Gain EXP by completing missions to level up.
b) Reward Types · Free Rewards: Available to all players · Premium Rewards: Unlocked after purchasing the Pass.

In this realm ruled by eternal winter, it accidentally touched the ancient "Arctic Authority"—the source of all cold and stillness. Only when the will of winter completely merged with it did the Authority cease to be an external force to be controlled, instead flowing as power within its veins. Now, cracks spread from within the ice, and the long slumber reaches its end. Kyogre awakens from the ice, its eyes harboring frost that spans the ages. It is no longer a Legendary Pokémon seeking power—it is the Northern Extreme itself.

Rule_Des_65:
1. Improve your Pokémon's overall strength and train the world's strongest Pokémon!
2. A Pokémon's overall strength is calculated from a certain proportion of its CP and battle proficiency.
3. Battle Proficiency
(1) Battle proficiency can be obtained by participating in the following PVP modes:
· Champion Road
· Elite Four Match
· Gym Leader Qualifier
· World Championship
(2) The following Pokémon actions can earn a certain amount of proficiency:
· Causing the opponent's Pokémon to faint
· Boosting your own stats or lowering the opponent's stats
· Landing a super effective move
· Inflicting a status condition on the opponent's Pokémon
(3) Depending on the battle outcome, the amount of proficiency points gained will receive different percentage bonuses!
(4) At the beginning of each month, each Pokémon's battle proficiency automatically decays by 50%.
4. Global Pokémon Ranking
(1) The number one ranked Pokémon will receive an exclusive aura effect for the strongest Pokémon!
(2) The ranking is based on the Pokémon's overall strength.
(3) The ranking includes both Shiny and non-Shiny Pokémon.

1. Gameplay Overview
a) Season Duration: 2026.03.03--2026.03.30
b) Matchmaking Hours: 0:00 – 2:00; 8:00 – 24:00
c) Matchmaking Rules:
· Cross-server matching, players with the same IP will not meet · Opponents are matched based on points, win/loss streaks.

2. Tiers & Ranking
a) Tier Promotion: Reach the required points to advance.
· Order Silver: 0~100 pts
· Glory Gold: 100~300 pts
· Noble Platinum: 300~600 pts
· Eternal Diamond: 600~900 pts
· Supreme Star: 900~1200 pts
· Ultimate King: 1200 pts & above
b) Leaderboard: Players who reach the Ultimate King tier will be ranked based on points.
· If points are tied, ranking is determined by who reached the tier first.

3. Battle System
a) Season Type: Mega Season
b) Battle Features:
· Random Scenes: Different scenes activate different statuses, terrains, and weather!
Water Terrain: At the end of the 3rd turn, confuses all non-Water-type Buddies on the field.
Grass Terrain: At the end of the 3rd turn, inflicts a 3-turn Bind on all non-Grass-type Buddies on the field. This Bind deals no damage and cannot be overridden.
Rock Terrain: Inflicts the Smack Down effect on all Buddies on the field.
Snow Terrain: After a Buddy remains on the field for 3 consecutive turns, at the end of each subsequent turn, that Buddy has a 30% chance to be Frozen.
c) Victory Condition: Win by making a specified number of opponent's Buddies faint.
d) Battle Modes:
· Below King Tier: Standard Battle. Start fighting directly.
· King Tier: BP (Ban/Pick) Battle. After selecting three Buddies from your lineup, the battle begins.

4. Reputation System
a) Starting Score: 100 pts
· Reputation score resets each season.
b) Score Deductions:
· Maliciously stalling turn time: After a warning, 1 point deducted per turn, max 10 points per match!
· BP Escape: From the second offense onward, 10 points deducted per escape!
c) Score Additions:
· No rule violations during the match: +1 Reputation point after the match ends.
d) Reputation Effects:
· Turn action time will be greatly reduced!
· Reduced Rewards: Lower reputation leads to more rewards deducted, up to 40%!
· If reputation falls below 50 points, you will be permanently banned for the remainder of the season!!!

5. Reward System
a) Battle Rewards: Earn Gold and Shard Coins after each match.
· Higher tiers grant more rewards. King Tier also grants rare Crystal Coins!
· Starting from the season launch, higher Gold reward caps unlock every 7 days!
· Starting from the season launch, Shard Coins/Crystal Coins refresh their current acquired values every 7 days!
b) Tier Achievement Rewards: Reach a new tier each season to claim corresponding rewards.
c) Tier Season-End Rewards: Rewards issued based on your final tier at season end.
· Complete 50/100 cumulative matches in Victory Road to boost season-end rewards by 5%/10%.
d) Ranking Rewards: Top 300 players on the leaderboard receive extra rewards after the season ends. Higher rank = better rewards.
e) Mission Rewards: Complete Daily/Weekly Missions for rewards.
· Weekly Mission refresh time: Refreshes every 7 days from the season start.
f) Season Shop: Use Season Tokens to exchange for precious season-limited items.

6. Season Pass
a) Level Up: Gain EXP by completing missions to level up.
b) Reward Types · Free Rewards: Available to all players · Premium Rewards: Unlocked after purchasing the Pass.

· Double Battles: Players will field two teams simultaneously, each with 3 Pokémon. Control both Pokémon in battle to win!
· Random Scenes: Different scenes will apply different statuses, fields, and weather!
Water Field: At the end of turn 3, inflicts confusion on all Pokémon on the field except Water-type Pokémon.
Grass Field: At the end of turn 3, inflicts a 3-turn bind on all Pokémon on the field except Grass-type Pokémon. This bind effect does not cause damage and cannot be overwritten.
Rock Field: Inflicts the Smack Down effect on all Pokémon on the field.
Snow Field: After a Pokémon remains on the field for 3 turns, at the end of each subsequent turn, that Pokémon has a 30% chance of being frozen.
c) Win Condition: Win by causing the opponent's Pokémon to reach a specified number of fainted Pokémon.
d) Battle Mode:
· Regular Battle. Start battling directly.

4. Credit System
a) Initial Score: 100 points
· Credit score resets each season.
b) Point Deduction Behaviors:
· Intentionally delaying turn time: If a player continues to deliberately delay time after a warning, 1 point is deducted per turn, up to a maximum of 10 points per match!
· BP Forfeiting: Starting from the second violation, 10 points are deducted for each forfeit!
c) Point Addition Behaviors:
· If no violations occur during the battle, 1 credit point is added after the battle ends.
d) Credit Score Effects:
· Turn action time will be significantly reduced!
· Reward Reduction: The lower the credit score, the more rewards are deducted, up to a maximum deduction of 40%!
· If the credit score falls below 50 points, the player will be permanently banned for the current season!!!

5. Reward System
a) Battle Rewards: Coins and Broken Jade Coins are awarded for each battle.
· The higher the rank, the more rewards. Players in the Strongest King rank can also receive rare Crystal Coin rewards!
· Starting from the beginning of the season, the maximum obtainable Coin reward cap increases every seven days.
· Starting from the beginning of the season, the current obtained values for Broken Jade Coins/Crystal Coins reset every seven days!
b) Rank Milestone Rewards: Reaching a new rank each season allows you to claim the corresponding rank milestone reward.
c) Rank Settlement Rewards: At the end of the season, rewards are given based on the final rank achieved.
· For accumulating 50/100 battles in Champion Road, settlement rewards increase by 5%/10%.
d) Ranking Rewards: Players ranked in the top 300 on the leaderboard will receive additional rewards after the season ends. The higher the rank, the better the rewards.
e) Mission Rewards: Complete daily/weekly missions to obtain mission rewards.
· Weekly Mission Reset: Missions reset every seven days from the start of the season.
f) Season Shop: Use season tokens to exchange for valuable season-limited items.

6. Season Pass
a) Level Up: Gain experience by completing missions to level up.
b) Reward Types:
· Free Rewards: Available to all players.
· Premium Rewards: Unlocked after purchasing the Season Pass.

NpcTalk_Des_900101: Before you know it, you've become a powerful trainer. That's amazing!
NpcTalk_Des_900102: But Professor, I want to become even stronger!
NpcTalk_Des_900103: Is there any way to make my Pokémon even better?
NpcTalk_Des_900104: In the Sinnoh region, there lives a group of incredibly powerful Pokémon. People call them "Kings."
NpcTalk_Des_900105: The immense power of the "Kings" all comes from the gift of the Great Sinnoh Deity - Arceus.
NpcTalk_Des_900106: However, earning Arceus's recognition is by no means an easy task.
NpcTalk_Des_900107: I believe the bond between my Pokémon and me can earn Arceus's recognition!
NpcTalk_Des_900108: Tell me where Arceus is, quick! I'll go right now!
NpcTalk_Des_900110: To pass Arceus's trial, your Pokémon need to be incredibly strong.
NpcTalk_Des_900111: Challenge other trainers. First, prove to me that you can achieve an overwhelming victory!
NpcTalk_Des_900301: Your Pokémon are truly not to be underestimated. I believe Arceus will surely acknowledge you!
NpcTalk_Des_900302: According to rumors from trainers in the Sinnoh region, you should be able to find it inside the Hall of Origin.
NpcTalk_Des_900303: Great! I'm on my way. Thank you, Professor!
NpcTalk_Des_900401: Seeker, I have heard your desire for power!
NpcTalk_Des_900402: However, the true essence of a "King" does not come from a gift, but is born from rigorous training.
NpcTalk_Des_900403: Prove to me that you and the partner you have chosen possess the capacity to command this great power.
NpcTalk_Des_900407: Go back! Your capacity is not yet sufficient to bear the weight of the crown.
NpcTalk_Des_900408: When you are ready again... I will be here, waiting for your challenge.
NpcTalk_Des_900410: You and your partner have proven you possess the capacity to bear the name "King," the resolve to command power without losing yourselves.
NpcTalk_Des_900411: Here, in the name of creation, with time and space as witness, I bestow upon you the true position of "King," and recognize your "King's" authority!
NpcTalk_Des_900412: From now on, your path will be different from the ordinary! Go, true king—your world has already begun a new chapter at your feet!

Eudemon_Des_11707: Born from the deepest core of the earth, Groudon took form with rock as its bones and land as its body. It crashed, sank, and rose amidst chaos, forging the very contours of the continent through sheer force. It is the embodiment of rock strata and the earth’s crust—for eons, it slumbered deep within the mantle, its body tempered ceaselessly by immense pressure and searing heat. Upon its surface crystallized primordial stone harder than any ore found in the Pokémon world, honing within it an unparalleled regenerative power. Unyielding rock grants it an invincible form; the boundless earth bestows it with limitless strength. Before it, all attacks are like stones striking iron. It is the true sovereign of the land—the ultimate fusion of rock and earth.

3. Battle System
a) Season Type: Mega Season
b) Battle Features:
· Random Scenes: Different scenes activate different statuses, terrains, and weather!
Water Terrain: At the end of the 3rd turn, confuses all non-Water-type Buddies on the field.
Grass Terrain: At the end of the 3rd turn, inflicts a 3-turn Bind on all non-Grass-type Buddies on the field. This Bind deals no damage and cannot be overridden.
Rock Terrain: Inflicts the Smack Down effect on all Buddies on the field.
Snow Terrain: After a Buddy remains on the field for 3 consecutive turns, at the end of each subsequent turn, that Buddy has a 30% chance to be Frozen.
c) Victory Condition: Win by making a specified number of opponent's Buddies faint.
d) Battle Modes:
· Below King Tier: Standard Battle. Start fighting directly.
· King Tier: BP (Ban/Pick) Battle. After selecting three Buddies from your lineup, the battle begins.

4. Reputation System
a) Starting Score: 100 pts
· Reputation score resets each season.
b) Score Deductions:
· Maliciously stalling turn time: After a warning, 1 point deducted per turn, max 10 points per match!
· BP Escape: From the second offense onward, 10 points deducted per escape!
c) Score Additions:
· No rule violations during the match: +1 Reputation point after the match ends.
d) Reputation Effects:
· Turn action time will be greatly reduced!
· Reduced Rewards: Lower reputation leads to more rewards deducted, up to 40%!
· If reputation falls below 50 points, you will be permanently banned for the remainder of the season!!!

5. Reward System
a) Battle Rewards: Earn Gold and Shard Coins after each match.
· Higher tiers grant more rewards. King Tier also grants rare Crystal Coins!
· Starting from the season launch, higher Gold reward caps unlock every 7 days!
· Starting from the season launch, Shard Coins/Crystal Coins refresh their current acquired values every 7 days!
b) Tier Achievement Rewards: Reach a new tier each season to claim corresponding rewards.
c) Tier Season-End Rewards: Rewards issued based on your final tier at season end.
· Complete 50/100 cumulative matches in Victory Road to boost season-end rewards by 5%/10%.
d) Ranking Rewards: Top 300 players on the leaderboard receive extra rewards after the season ends. Higher rank = better rewards.
e) Mission Rewards: Complete Daily/Weekly Missions for rewards.
· Weekly Mission refresh time: Refreshes every 7 days from the season start.
f) Season Shop: Use Season Tokens to exchange for precious season-limited items.

6. Season Pass

b) Reward Types · Free Rewards: Available to all players · Premium Rewards: Unlocked after purchasing the Pass.

One wielded a sacred sword that cuts through all obstacles, while the other bore an unbreakable divine shield. The two monarchs, who once guarded the realm alone, set aside their solitary ways in the face of the apocalyptic threat. Standing upon the brink of ruin, they rode into battle side by side.Zacian sliced through Eternatus’ energy beams with its blade, and Zamazenta blocked the devastating blows with its sturdy shield. Fighting in perfect offensive and defensive unison, they endured a brutal, desperate battle. Together they sealed Eternatus, ended the calamity of The Darkest Day, and saved the entire Galar region.

1. Gameplay Instructions
a) Season Duration: 2026.09.05--2026.10.02
b) Matchmaking Times: 0:00 – 2:00; 8:00 – 24:00
c) Matchmaking Rules:
· Cross-server matchmaking; players with the same IP will not meet.
· Opponents are matched based on points and win/loss streaks.

2. Ranks and Rankings
a) Rank Promotion: Promote when points reach the requirement.
· Order Silver: 0–100 points
· Glory Gold: 100–300 points
· Noble Platinum: 300–600 points
· Eternal Diamond: 600–900 points
· Supreme Star: 900–1200 points
· Strongest King: 1200 points and above
b) Ranking: Players who reach the Strongest King rank will be ranked by points.
· If points are tied, ranking is determined by the order of promotion; players who promoted earlier rank higher.

3. Battle System
a) Season Type: Ultimate Talent
b) Battle Mechanics:
· Talent Bonus: Earn talent points through battles, upgrade the talent tree, and gain stronger attribute bonuses!
· Random Scenes: Different scenes apply different statuses, fields, and weather!
Water Field: At the end of turn 3, inflicts confusion on all Pokémon on the field except Water-type Pokémon.
Grass Field: At the end of turn 3, inflicts a 3-turn bind on all Pokémon on the field except Grass-type Pokémon. This bind effect does not cause damage and cannot be overwritten.
Rock Field: Inflicts the Smack Down effect on all Pokémon on the field.
Snow Field: After a Pokémon remains on the field for 3 turns, at the end of each subsequent turn, that Pokémon has a 30% chance of being frozen.
c) Win Condition: Win by causing the opponent's Pokémon to reach a specified number of fainted Pokémon.
d) Battle Modes:
· Ranks below King: Regular battle. Start battling directly.
· King Rank: BP battle. After selecting three Pokémon to send out from your battle lineup, start the battle.

4. Credit System
a) Initial Score: 100 points
· Credit score resets each season.
b) Point Deduction Behaviors:
· Intentionally delaying turn time: If a player continues to deliberately delay time after a warning, 1 point is deducted per turn, up to a maximum of 10 points per match!
· BP Forfeiting: Starting from the second violation, 10 points are deducted for each forfeit!
c) Point Addition Behaviors:
· If no violations occur during the battle, 1 credit point is added after the battle ends.
d) Credit Score Effects:
· Turn action time will be significantly reduced!
· Reward Reduction: The lower the credit score, the more rewards are deducted, up to a maximum deduction of 40%!
· If the credit score falls below 50 points, the player will be permanently banned for the current season!!!

5. Reward System
a) Battle Rewards: Coins and Broken Jade Coins are awarded for each battle.
· The higher the rank, the more rewards. Players in the Strongest King rank can also receive rare Crystal Coin rewards!
· Starting from the beginning of the season, the maximum obtainable Coin reward cap increases every seven days.
· Starting from the beginning of the season, the current obtained values for Broken Jade Coins/Crystal Coins reset every seven days!
b) Rank Milestone Rewards: Reaching a new rank each season allows you to claim the corresponding rank milestone reward.
c) Rank Settlement Rewards: At the end of the season, rewards are given based on the final rank achieved.
· For accumulating 50/100 battles in Champion Road, settlement rewards increase by 5%/10%.
d) Ranking Rewards: Players ranked in the top 300 on the leaderboard will receive additional rewards after the season ends. The higher the rank, the better the rewards.
e) Mission Rewards: Complete daily/weekly missions to obtain mission rewards.
· Weekly Mission Reset: Missions reset every seven days from the start of the season.
f) Season Shop: Use season tokens to exchange for valuable season-limited items.
